$meta.notes: Braced tokens like {n} stand for runtime values. A phase without a short entry uses its label. Crew plurals (Weavers, Masters) collapse into the single Chinese form. The sentences group adds every remaining captain facing line, keyed by sweep and number in the same order the sentence tables read. Tokens there take their final names from source when the file lifts into the repo.

mode.classic.tagline.en: The harbor as it has always run.

mode.classic.summary.en: The founding voyage. Buy the port, work the orders, trade with the table between rounds, settle, and refit.
mode.classic.summary.zh: 最初的航程。在港口采购，交付订单，与同席船长易货，结算账目，再整备船只。

mode.ocean_gambit.tagline.en: Orders lock before the table opens.
mode.ocean_gambit.tagline.zh: 订单先落定，众人再开口。

mode.ocean_gambit.summary.en: Trade orders are committed before the social window opens, so a promise about what you are going to do can be broken invisibly.
mode.ocean_gambit.summary.zh: 订单在众人开口之前便已落定，一句承诺能否兑现，旁人无从知晓。

difficulty.fair_winds.tagline.en: A gentle passage for new captains.
difficulty.fair_winds.tagline.zh: 新船长的一段轻松航路。

difficulty.fair_winds.summary.en: Eight rounds on the founding trade. A short, legible voyage with room to learn the rhythm before the money runs tight.
difficulty.fair_winds.summary.zh: 八轮初创贸易，用一段简短而精炼的旅程，让你在陷入贫困之前熟悉游戏节奏。

difficulty.open_waters.tagline.en: The full trade opens as the harbor grows busy.

difficulty.open_waters.summary.en: Twelve rounds. The charter opens twice and the market swells from six cards to ten, with pirates that begin to bite past the midpoint.
difficulty.open_waters.summary.zh: 十二轮贸易，特许开放两次，货架由六张增至十张。半程过后，海盗开始汹涌来袭。

difficulty.monsoon.tagline.en: A long, adversarial haul for seasoned captains.

difficulty.monsoon.summary.en: Sixteen rounds, back loaded and unforgiving. The market swells to eleven cards, the largest imperial mandates fall late, and a corrupt broker may leak your position to the pirates.
difficulty.monsoon.summary.zh: 十六轮贸易，重负在背，毫不留情。货架扩至十一张，最重要的皇命采办压在尾声。通匪的掮客甚至可能向海盗泄露你的位置。

path.convoy.signature.en: Protect another captain's haul: sell one leg of protection for a price you both agree, and a raid that would have hit them meets your cannons instead.
path.convoy.signature.zh: 为他人护货：把一段航段的护卫按双方议定的价格卖出，本该落在对方头上的劫掠，改由你的炮口接下。

path.loom.signature.en: Refit another captain's garments at port, faster and cheaper than they could manage alone, and hold the crafting chain that makes them.
path.loom.signature.zh: 在港口为他人的衣物整补翻新，比他们亲自打理更快、更省，并握有织成它们的整条工序。

path.aroma.signature.en: Publish a rumor that shifts the next port's price band for one commodity; the fleet sees that you spoke and which good you named, and only you know which way you are leaning.
path.aroma.signature.zh: 放出风声，拨动某件货物在下一港的价格。船队看得见你开了口、点的是哪件货，只有你知道自己押的是哪一边。

guides.011.en:
This voyage does not play like the founding one. Here is what {play.badge} changes about it, all of it:

    {items}

Everything else is the voyage you would sail in Classic, so everything you learn there carries over. You can read the same list any time with F1.
guides.011.zh:
这趟航程跟最初那趟不一样。以下是 {play.badge} 带来的全部改动：

    {items}

其余的跟经典航程一样，你在经典里学到的都管用。随时按 F1 重看这份清单。

guides.012.en:
The voyage opens with a deal rather than a market. Three cards land face down in front of you, and at each beat you keep one and pass the rest on. What you hold when the deal ends is your path, and it sails with you to the end of the voyage. One change of papers is allowed: at a port, for a fee in Gold that grows with your Renown, the path chip in your rail offers the switch.

Your path decides three things about your seat: your hold, how far your Renown can climb, and which trade orders lock to you. An order demanding a locked good can only be filled by the captain holding the path that carries it.

    {rows}

Every card in the deal carries these numbers, so what you read here is what the table deals you.
guides.012.zh:
这趟航程以发牌开局，而不是开市。三张牌背面朝上落在你面前，一路留一张、传走其余。发牌结束时留在手上的，就是你的商道，它会陪你走到航程尽头。商道可以换一次：在港口花一笔金币，价格随声望涨，船长栏里的商道小牌就能换。

你的商道定下你席位的三件事：货舱多大、声望最高能爬到哪、哪些订单只认这条道。遇上要专属货物的订单，全桌只有持那条商道的船长接得下。

    {rows}

牌桌上的每张牌都带这些数字，这里读到的就是你会拿到的。

guides.013.en:
{APP_NAME} puts you on the ancient Silk Road: one voyage of {rounds} rounds, limited gold, and a lot of merchants trying to outmaneuver you at every port.

You are sailing {play.badge}: {play.tagline}

These waters are {cfg.name}: {cfg.tagline}

The rules are easy to pick up, but money is tight early on and a string of bad calls compounds quickly. This covers the things that catch new captains out most.

Two minutes to read. Saves a lot of frustrated restarts.
guides.013.zh:
{APP_NAME} 把你带上了古丝路：{rounds}轮的航程，有限的金币，还有一群商人，个个都想在每个港口比你多走一步。

你走的是{play.badge}：{play.tagline}

这片水域是{cfg.name}：{cfg.tagline}

规则好上手，只是前期手头紧，一连串坏判断很快就会滚成雪球。这里讲的是新船长最容易栽的几件事。

两分钟读完，能省下好几次懊恼的重开。

{rounds}轮之后，声誉最高的船长赢得沧海之主的头衔。声誉来自贸易利润和完成的订单。

guides.015.en:
A round is one lap of the voyage, and this voyage runs {rounds} of them. Each round walks the phases below in the order your voyage puts them:

{roundSteps}

Ctrl+N readies you for the next phase without clicking (the room sails on once every captain is ready), and a voyage is one whole run of these rounds rather than a round of its own.
guides.015.zh:
一轮是航程里的一圈，这趟要走{rounds}轮。每轮依次走过下面的阶段，顺序由你的航程排定：

{roundSteps}

Ctrl+N 可以不点鼠标直接就绪（所有船长都就绪，港湾才继续）；航程是这些轮连起来的一整趟，不是单独的一轮。

guides.016.en:
The port market has Hemp, Silk, and Tea at prices that shift every round. Buy here, barter with the other captains at Parley, and fill trade orders at Orders. Which of those two stops comes first is a rule of the voyage you are sailing rather than a choice you make, and your captain's rail always shows the order. That is the core loop.

One thing worth knowing about: the Broker. Pay a small fee for a demand rumor and a specific trade order is guaranteed to appear when Orders opens. Useful when you have stocked a particular good and want to make sure a buyer shows up.

💡 For the first two or three voyages, stick to raw materials. You can fill an order with them the same round you buy them. No waiting and no risk.
guides.016.zh:
集市里有麻布、丝绸和茶叶，价格每轮都在动。在这里采购，到洽谈去易货，去订单交单。开市和订单谁先谁后，由你所走航程的规则定，没得选，船长栏里一直标着顺序。这就是核心循环。

还有一个人要记住：掮客。花点小钱买一条需求密语，订单一开，指定的那张必定出现。囤着货想保准有买家，就用这个。

💡 最初两三趟航程，先做原材料。买进的当轮就能拿去交订单，不用等，也没有风险。

guides.017.en:
The Parley is a short window where captains trade directly with each other instead of through the market. Post an offer, like Hemp you don't need for Silk you do, and any other captain in the harbor can take it with one click.

Where it falls in the round is set by the voyage you are sailing rather than changing from round to round: {MODES.classic.badge} runs it right after Market, and {MODES.ocean_gambit.badge} runs it right after Orders, and your captain's rail always shows which. Either way, it is the easiest way to recover from a bad draw. All Tea and no Silk, with a Sachet order already on the board? Someone else in the harbor has probably drawn the opposite problem.

A few ground rules: you can't offer an item for itself, both amounts have to be whole numbers of at least one, and you can never offer more than you currently have. The moment you post an offer, that amount is set aside until someone takes it or you cancel it.

Nobody has to barter. If nothing on the board interests you, or nobody is offering anything, just move on to the next phase.
guides.017.zh:
洽谈只开一扇短窗，船长们绕开集市直接易货。挂一份单子，比如拿富余的麻布换你缺的丝绸，港湾里谁都能一点接下。

洽谈落在轮里的哪一步，由你的航程定，不随轮次变：{MODES.classic.badge}排在开市之后，{MODES.ocean_gambit.badge}排在订单之后，船长栏一直标着是哪种。哪种都好，它都是纠坏手气最省事的办法。手里全是茶叶没有丝绸，订单板上却挂着一张香囊单？港湾里多半有人正好反过来。

几条规矩：不能拿一样货换它本身；两边的数量都得是整数，至少各 1；挂出的数量不能超过你手头的。挂出那一刻，这些货就寄存起来，直到有人接下或你取消。

没人非得易货。板上没你想要的，或者没人挂东西，直接走下一阶段。

guides.018.en:
Trade orders appear and you match your cargo to them. Each one shows the goods needed, the reward, and the shipping fee. Your take is whatever is left after fees and tax.

You can fill as many orders as your cargo allows while Orders is open.

📌 Finished goods ({tier0List}) pay two to three times more than raw materials. The catch is they need artisans, and the artisans deliver at Resolve. That is covered next.
guides.018.zh:
订单上板了，拿货去对。每条都写明要什么货、给多少报酬、收多少运费。运费和税扣完，剩下的都归你。

订单开着的时候，货够就交，能交几条交几条。

📌 成品 ({tier0List})的报酬是原材料的两三倍。可它得靠工匠，工匠要到结算才交货。下一页就讲这个。

guides.019.en:
Artisans turn raw materials into high value finished goods and collect wages at every Resolve. That part is simple. What catches most new captains is this:

Assign a task this round.
Wages come due at Resolve either way.

Weavers ({weaverWage}g), Master Weavers ({masterWage}g), and Sachet Makers ({sachetWage}g) all charge wages every round, even when idle, so the bill comes round whether they worked or not. Only hire once you have enough gold to cover at least two rounds of wages alongside your other bills.
guides.019.zh:
工匠把原材料做成高价成品，每个结算都领工钱。这部分很简单。让新船长栽跟头的是这一点：

本轮派活。
工钱到结算照付不误。

织女（{weaverWage}g）、纺织大师（{masterWage}g）、香囊师（{sachetWage}g）的工钱每轮都付，闲着照付，干不干活账单都来。手里的金币能盖住至少两轮工钱、还顾得开别的开销，再雇人。

guides.020.en: 💡 {ESCORT_SHARE_RULE} Often worth it once your funds are already thin.
guides.020.zh: 💡 {ESCORT_SHARE_RULE}手头紧的时候，这笔往往划算。

guides.021.en:
Once the pirates are dealt with, two bills come due:

🔧
Ship Maintenance
15 to 22 Gold each round, set by the waters you sail
👥
Artisan Wages
{ARTISAN_WAGE_MIN} to {ARTISAN_WAGE_MAX} Gold per person per round

The Dues tab of your captain's rail shows exactly what is owed. Check it before spending anything.

Coming up short isn't the end on its own. Right there on the settlement screen, you can ask another captain in the harbor for a loan, and they can send it to you on the spot if they've got the Gold to spare. Just repay it before the voyage's last round ends, or it comes out of your funds automatically and goes straight to them.
guides.021.zh:
海盗的事了结之后，还有两笔账单：

🔧
船只维护费
每轮15到22金币，由你走的水域决定
👥
工匠工钱
每人每轮{ARTISAN_WAGE_MIN}到{ARTISAN_WAGE_MAX}金币

船长栏里的港务费页签写着确切欠多少。花钱之前先看一眼。

钱不够，本身不是终点。就在结算界面上，你可以向港湾里的其他船长借一笔；对方手头宽裕，当场就能转给你。在航程最后一轮结束前还上就行，还不清，会自动从你的金币里扣出来，交到他手上。

guides.022.en:
Keep these points in mind as you play:

  • Start with raw material orders. Fast money, no complications.
  • Always keep at least 30 Gold above what Resolve will cost you.
  • Hire artisans only when you can cover two full rounds of wages.
  • Dusk ship upgrades compound quickly. Do not skip them.
  • Caught short by pirates or a bad round? When other captains are aboard, ask the harbor for a loan before you assume the voyage is over.
  • Every voyage's final Reputation becomes Renown on your account, forever, win or lose. Check your Captain's Legacy any time from the Lobby.
  • Ctrl+S saves your voyage  ·  F1 opens the full guide.
Good winds and good margins, Captain. ⚓
guides.022.zh:
玩的时候记住这几点：

  • 先从原材料订单做起。回钱快，不复杂。
  • 手里的金币，始终比结算要收的多出至少30金币。
  • 盖得住整整两轮工钱再雇工匠。
  • 暮色的船只升级会滚雪球，别跳过。
  • 被海盗或一轮背运打个措手不及？有其他船长在船上时，别急着认输，先向港湾借一笔。
  • 不管输赢，航程结束时的声誉都会永远变成账号上的声望。在大厅随时能看你的船长传承。
  • Ctrl+S 保存本航程  ·  F1 打开完整指南。
顺风又厚利，船长。⚓

guides.092.en:
🚢 Objective:
Sail one voyage of {rounds} rounds, and finish it with the highest Reputation in the harbor.
guides.092.zh:
🚢 目标：
走完这趟{rounds}轮的航程，收尾时拥有港湾里最高的声誉。

guides.102.en: • VAT: {vatPct}% on finished product profit margin

guides.103.en: • Income Tax: {incomeTaxPct}% on your net profit for the round, charged at Resolve after everything else is paid
guides.103.zh: • 所得税：对本轮净利润征 {incomeTaxPct}% 的税，在结算时、其余账付清之后收

guides.105.en: • Market: Click "Broker's Rumor Board" to open the window
guides.105.zh: • 集市：点掮客密语板，窗口就开

guides.106.en: • Spend {INTEL_COST} Gold to buy a "rumor" about Orders demand
guides.106.zh: • 花 {INTEL_COST} 金币，买一条关于订单需求的密语

guides.107.en: • Revealed intel guarantees matching orders will appear
guides.107.zh: • 买到的情报保证引出对得上的订单

guides.108.en: • A rumor is always true and always delivered, on every tier
guides.108.zh: • 密语句句为真、条条送达，哪个难度都一样

guides.109.en: • Here a broker may still be corrupt: you get the true rumor, but your position leaks and this round's raid risk rises, and the log tells you when
guides.109.zh: • 在这片水域，掮客可能是黑的：密语照真照送，可你的位置会走漏，本轮的劫掠风险跟着上涨，日志会写明

guides.111.en: • Trade directly with the other captains in your harbor while the Parley is open, whether it falls before or after Orders on your voyage
guides.111.zh: • 洽谈开着的时候，绕开集市，直接和港湾里的其他船长易货，不管它排在你航程里订单的前面还是后面

guides.112.en: • Post what you have and what you want for it; anyone can accept it with one click
guides.112.zh: • 挂出你有的、写明你想要的；谁都能一点接下

guides.113.en: • An offer can't be an item for itself, and both amounts must be whole numbers of at least 1
guides.113.zh: • 不能拿一样货换它本身；两边的数量都得是整数，至少各 1

guides.114.en: • You can never offer more than you currently own, it's set aside the moment you post, and returned to you if you cancel or nobody takes it
guides.114.zh: • 挂出的数量不能超过你手头有的；挂出那一刻就寄存起来，你取消或没人接，就原样归还

guides.115.en: • Want to make sure a specific captain gets your offer, not whoever clicks fastest? Pick their name under "With" when you post: only the two of you will ever see it
guides.115.zh: • 想让报价稳稳落进某位船长手里，而不是谁点得快谁得？挂单时在给谁一栏点他的名字：这份报价只有你们俩看得到

guides.117.en: • Dusk: Upgrade your ship to unlock Module Slots
guides.117.zh: • 暮色：升级船只，解锁模块槽位

guides.118.en: • Draft powerful modules to create unique synergies
guides.118.zh: • 抽选强力模块，凑出独一份的组合

guides.119.en: • Swap modules to adapt to your current voyage!
guides.119.zh: • 换模块，随这趟航程随时调整！

guides.121.en: • Resolve: {raidKind} Pirates take every Gold coin you carry.
guides.121.zh: • 结算时：{raidKind}海盗会拿走你身上的每一个金币。

guides.122.en: • Hire an escort for {escortShare} of current Gold to sail safe
guides.122.zh: • 花当前金币的 {escortShare} 雇一艘护航，稳稳驶过

guides.123.en: • Decide before the pirate roll happens that round
guides.123.zh: • 要做决定，得赶在那轮海盗掷点之前

guides.125.en: • On round{pluralS} {mandateList} the Emperor commissions one large order at a fixed reward
guides.125.zh: • 第 {mandateList} 轮上，皇帝下旨采办一大笔订单，报酬固定

guides.126.en: • A mandate is the only order exempt from VAT
guides.126.zh: • 皇命是唯一免增值税的订单

guides.127.en: • Every captain in the harbor is dealt the same mandate, so it is a race
guides.127.zh: • 港湾里每位船长拿到的皇命都一样，抢的就是速度

guides.129.en: • Whichever captain is first in the harbor to complete {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD} trade orders total this voyage wins {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_REWARD} Gold on the spot
guides.129.zh: • 本航程里，港湾中头一个交满 {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD} 笔贸易订单的船长，当场赢得 {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_REWARD} 金币

guides.130.en: • It's a race against the rest of the harbor, not a scheduled event: it can land on any round, for any captain
guides.130.zh: • 这是和港湾其余人的赛跑，不是排好的日程：哪一轮、落在哪位船长头上都有可能

guides.131.en: • Announced to the whole harbor the moment it's won, same as any other harbor wide milestone
guides.131.zh: • 赢下的那一刻全港湾通报，和港湾里其他大事件一个待遇

guides.133.en: • Once everyone in the harbor's own Reputation adds up past {TIDEWATCH_SURGE_THRESHOLD}, the harbor takes notice of a bustling crew
guides.133.zh: • 港湾里所有人的声誉加起来越过 {TIDEWATCH_SURGE_THRESHOLD}，港湾就瞧见这支船队忙起来了

guides.134.en: • From the next Port Purchase onward, every captain's board gets one extra cargo lot, for the rest of the voyage
guides.134.zh: • 从下一次港口采购起，本航程余下的每一轮，每位船长的板上都多一件货物

guides.135.en: • This never changes your voyage length or which tier's goods you see, only how busy the market gets
guides.135.zh: • 这不会改航程的长短，也不改你见到哪一档的货，只是让集市更热闹

guides.137.en: • Found on the Dues tab of your captain's rail: any captain can post a venture, a Gold target and a deadline round
guides.137.zh: • 在船长栏的港务费页签里：任何船长都能发起一份合股，写清目标金币和截止轮次

guides.138.en: • Anyone in the harbor, including the poster, can chip in Gold toward that target at any time before the deadline
guides.138.zh: • 港湾里任何人，发起人自己也算，都能在截止前随时往里投金币

guides.139.en: • Reach the target in time and it fills: every contributor is paid back {payoutPct}% more Gold than they put in, split in exact proportion to their share
guides.139.zh: • 按期凑够就成立：每位出资人拿回比本金多 {payoutPct}% 的金币，按出资比例分毫不差地分

guides.140.en: • Miss the deadline and it fails: every contributor only gets back {refundPct}% of their own stake, the rest is lost
guides.140.zh: • 过了截止还没凑够就失败：每位出资人只拿回本金的 {refundPct}%，其余的就没了

guides.141.en: • Contributing is a real wager on the rest of the harbor coming through, not a free favor
guides.141.zh: • 出资是拿真金赌港湾的其余人靠得住，不是白送的人情

guides.142.en: • Your whole harbor only ever gets one filled venture per voyage: the moment any venture fills, every other open venture is canceled and fully refunded, and posting a new one is disabled until the next voyage
guides.142.zh: • 整个港湾每趟航程只成立一份合股：任何一份一成立，其余还开着的全部取消、全额退还，本航程也不能再发起新的

guides.143.en: • A deadline can never land on your voyage's final round: it always leaves at least one full round afterward to actually spend whatever you're paid
guides.143.zh: • 截止轮次绝不会落在航程的最后一轮：后面总留足至少一整轮，让你真能把拿到的金币花出去

guides.144.en: • No single captain can ever fund more than {maxShare}% of a venture's target alone: it always needs at least one other captain to fund the rest before it can fill
guides.144.zh: • 任何一位船长单独出资都不得超过目标金额的 {maxShare}%：想成立，总得另有船长补齐剩下的

guides.146.en: • Can't cover this round's wages or maintenance? When other captains are aboard, ask the harbor for a loan, right on the settlement screen
guides.146.zh: • 这轮的工钱或维护费付不出来？船上有别的船长时，就在结算界面向港湾借一笔

guides.147.en: • Any captain with enough Gold can lend it to you on the spot; it's in your hands immediately
guides.147.zh: • 金币够的船长当场就能借给你，钱立刻到你手上

guides.148.en: • Repay it any time before the voyage's last round ends, or it's taken from your funds automatically and handed to your lender
guides.148.zh: • 航程最后一轮结束前随时还上；还不清，会自动从你的金币里扣出来，交到借你的人手上

guides.149.en: • Still short when the voyage finishes? That unpaid loan is what bankrupts you, not the round it was borrowed in
guides.149.zh: • 航程走完还欠着？让你破产的是那笔没还的借款，不是借它的那一轮

guides.150.en: • Lending Gold raises your own reputation, scaled to how much you lent
guides.150.zh: • 借出金币会抬高你自己的声誉，借得越多涨得越多

guides.152.en: • Every outstanding loan in your harbor is visible on the settlement screen, to everyone, not just the lender and borrower
guides.152.zh: • 港湾里每一笔没还清的借款都摆在结算界面上，所有人可见，不只是借贷两家

guides.153.en: • A third captain can back one: pledge some of their own Gold as a safety net for the lender, escrowed the instant they pledge it
guides.153.zh: • 第三位船长可以作保：押上自己的金币，给借出方兜底，押出的那一刻就寄存起来

guides.154.en: • Only spent if the loan actually defaults, and only up to whatever was pledged; the lender still eats any shortfall past that
guides.154.zh: • 只有借款真的违约才会动用，而且动用不超过押数；超出押数的窟窿，仍由借出方自己扛

guides.155.en: • Never called on when the loan is repaid in full? The whole pledge comes back, plus a small Reputation bonus for the risk paying off
guides.155.zh: • 借款全额还清、保金没被动过？押数原样奉还，还附带一小笔声誉奖励，赏这份风险没白担

guides.156.en: • One backer per loan; you can't back a loan you're the lender or borrower on yourself
guides.156.zh: • 每笔借款只认一位保人；自己借的、自己放的，都不能自己保

guides.158.en: • Every voyage's final Reputation becomes Renown XP on your account the moment the voyage ends, win or lose
guides.158.zh: • 不管输赢，航程一结束，最终声誉立刻变成账号上的声望经验

guides.159.en: • Renown is permanent: it survives a restart and carries into every future voyage, in any harbor, unlike Gold, cargo, and ship level
guides.159.zh: • 声望是永久的：重开也带得走，往后每一趟航程、哪个港湾都能带上，金币、货物和船只等级做不到

guides.160.en: • Whoever ends a voyage with the highest Reputation among everyone who reached the endgame screen is crowned Sea Master
guides.160.zh: • 走到终局画面的所有船长里，最终声誉最高的那位加冕沧海之主

guides.161.en: • Check your current Renown level, title, and Sea Master crowns any time from the Lobby
guides.161.zh: • 当前的声望等级、称号和沧海之主的冠数，在大厅随时能看

guides.023.en:
Before the bills below come due each round, the pirates roll for your ship. {raidKind} A raid takes every coin you're carrying.

You get one choice before that roll happens: hire an escort for {escortShare} of your current Gold and sail through guaranteed safe, or set sail anyway and keep the Gold if the pirates don't show.
guides.023.zh:
每轮账单到期之前，海盗会先为你的船掷上一把。{raidKind}一场劫掠下来，你带的钱会被搜刮一空。

掷这一下之前，你还有得选：花现有金币的 {escortShare}雇一艘护航，保证平安过关；或者照常起航碰运气，海盗不来，那笔金币就省下。

guides.024.en: The harbor's escort, hired at Resolve by any captain: guarantees safe passage from that round's pirate attack, for a fee the charter sets as a share of your Gold: {escortLadder}. Once hired, the round's pirates are no longer a risk.
guides.024.zh: 港湾的护航，任何船长都能在结算时雇用：保你免受本轮海盗劫掠，费用按章程定，取现有金币的一个比例：{escortLadder}。雇下之后，本轮的海盗就不再是威胁。

guides.026.en: A Convoy path market at the Parley on a Gambit voyage: a Convoy captain sells one leg of protection to one other captain at a price the two of them agree. The buyer pays the fee at the handshake, the seller's cannons beat off {convoyCoverPct}% of a raid in that leg, and the rest comes out of the seller's own Gold. {ESCORT_OFFER_DEATH}
guides.026.zh: 暗潮航程里洽谈场上的镖行买卖：镖行船长把一段航段的护卫卖给另一位船长，价格两人自己谈。买家在成交时付清费用，卖家的炮火挡下该航段 {convoyCoverPct}% 的劫掠，剩下的从卖家自己的金币里出。{ESCORT_OFFER_DEATH}

guides.087.en: A roll at Resolve, before wages and maintenance come due, that can take every Gold coin you're carrying. The charter sets the odds: {pirateLadder}. Hire an escort beforehand to guarantee safe passage instead of risking it.
guides.087.zh: 结算时掷上一把，赶在工钱和维护费到期之前，你身上带的每一枚金币都可能被搜刮一空。章程定下概率：{pirateLadder}。想稳当过关，提前雇一艘护航，不用冒这个险。

guides.028.en: A cheap raw material, bought at port. Weavers turn it into Linen Clothes, or combine it with Silk for Cotton Clothes.
guides.028.zh: 在港口就能买到的便宜原材料。织女拿它做麻衣，或配上丝绸做布衣。

guides.029.en: A pricier raw material. Goes into Cotton Clothes, Brocade, and Sachets. Most of the high value recipes need it.
guides.029.zh: 贵一档的原材料，用来做布衣、绫罗绸缎和香囊。高价值配方大多少不了它。

guides.030.en: A raw material used only in Sachets, alongside Silk.
guides.030.zh: 只和丝绸搭配、专用于香囊的原材料。

guides.031.en: A Weaver's product: 2 Hemp in, one item out. The cheapest finished good to produce.
guides.031.zh: 织女的成品：2麻布进，1件出。是成本最低的成品。

guides.032.en: A Weaver's product: 2 Hemp + 1 Silk in. Worth more than Linen Clothes, costs more to make.
guides.032.zh: 织女的成品：2麻布加1丝绸。比麻衣值钱，成本也高。

guides.033.en: A Master Weaver's product: 3 Silk in. One of the two highest value finished goods.
guides.033.zh: 纺织大师的成品：3丝绸。最值钱的两种成品之一。

guides.034.en: A Sachet Maker's product: 1 Silk + 2 Tea in. The most valuable finished good, and the only one that needs Tea.
guides.034.zh: 香囊师的成品：1丝绸加2茶叶。成品里最值钱的，也是唯一吃茶叶的。

guides.035.en: Makes Linen Clothes or Cotton Clothes. Costs a wage every round, paid at Resolve, whether or not they're working.
guides.035.zh: 做麻衣和布衣。工钱每轮照付，结算时结清，干不干活都一样。

guides.036.en: Makes Linen Clothes, Cotton Clothes, or Brocade. Pricier than a Weaver, and the only one who can make Brocade.
guides.036.zh: 做麻衣、布衣和绫罗绸缎。身价比织女高，也是唯一会做绫罗绸缎的。

guides.037.en: Makes Sachets. The most expensive artisan to hire, but Sachets pay the best.
guides.037.zh: 制作香囊。雇价最高的工匠，但香囊的报酬也最高。

guides.038.en: Your score for the voyage, roughly your accumulated trading profit. Highest reputation on the voyage's final round wins.
guides.038.zh: 你在本航程的积分，大致就是累积的贸易利润。最后一轮结束时声誉最高的人获胜。

guides.039.en: Your standing across every harbor, kept on the account rather than in one voyage: the Reputation you bank becomes Renown XP when a voyage ends. {RENOWN_BONUS_LINE}. The title beside your level is the ladder's own name for the rung you have reached.
guides.039.zh: 你在所有港湾之间的地位，记在账号上，不随某次航程走：航程结束时，你攒下的声誉会变成声望经验。{RENOWN_BONUS_LINE}。等级旁的称号，就是这条阶梯给这一级的名字。

guides.040.en: Your spendable funds. Hit zero with bills still due and the voyage ends in bankruptcy.
guides.040.zh: 你手头可用的金币。账单还没付完就见底，航程以破产收场。

guides.041.en: A {vatPct}% tax on the profit margin of finished good sales (selling price minus material cost minus wage). Raw material sales aren't taxed this way.
guides.041.zh: 对成品的利润（售价减原料成本再减工钱）征 {vatPct}% 的税。卖原材料不在此列。

guides.042.en: A {incomeTaxPct}% tax on your net profit for the round, charged at Resolve after everything else is paid.
guides.042.zh: 对本轮净利润征 {incomeTaxPct}% 的税，在结算时、其余账付清之后收。

guides.043.en: The shipping fee for completing a trade order, based on how many items you're moving. Reduced by your ship level and certain boons or modules.
guides.043.zh: 交一条订单要付的运费，按件数算。船只等级，以及某些机缘和模块，能把它压低。

guides.044.en: A fixed per round upkeep fee for your ship, due at Resolve regardless of how the round went.
guides.044.zh: 每轮固定的船只维护，不论这轮走得如何，结算时都要交。

guides.045.en: Raises your module slots and gives a flat discount on freight costs. Upgraded from the Shipyard at Dusk.
guides.045.zh: 多给一个模块槽位，运费也定额往下压。在暮色的船坞升级。

guides.046.en: What your hired artisans cost per round, paid at Resolve whether they produced anything or not.
guides.046.zh: 雇来的工匠每轮的开销，结算时付，产出与否都得付。

guides.047.en: A one round bonus you draft at the start of each round, at Dawn. It's picked personally, so your three choices differ from everyone else's.
guides.047.zh: 每轮开局、破晓时抽的机缘，只保一轮。三张牌单发给你，和别人的都不重样。

guides.048.en: A permanent ship upgrade, drafted from the Shipyard once you have a free slot. Stays equipped until you swap it out.
guides.048.zh: 永久的船只升级，有空余槽位时在船坞抽取。装上就一直在，直到你把它换掉。

guides.049.en: Trade directly with another captain instead of through the market, on the Captain's Exchange during the Parley or from the harbor chat once you reach Renown Level {FLEXIBLE_BARTER_UNLOCK_LEVEL}. Post what you have for what you want; the offered amount is set aside the moment you post it, and comes back to you if it's canceled, if nobody takes it, or if a flexible offer of yours is taken and this one is retired with it.
guides.049.zh: 绕开集市，直接和另一位船长易货：洽谈时的船长行市，或声望到 {FLEXIBLE_BARTER_UNLOCK_LEVEL}级后的港湾聊天。挂出你有的、写明你想要的；挂出的那一刻数量就寄存起来，被取消、没人接，或者你的另一份灵活挂单成交、把它一并带走，都会原样回到你手上。

guides.052.en: A loan from another captain when you can't cover this round's wages or maintenance on your own. The lender's Gold transfers to you immediately; you owe it back before the voyage ends, or it's deducted automatically and handed to them at the voyage's final round.
guides.052.zh: 自己盖不住本轮的工钱或维护费时，向另一位船长借的一笔款。对方的金币立刻到账；在航程结束前还清，还不清，最后一轮会自动从你的金币里扣下来，交到他手上。

guides.053.en: The round's opening phase: the boon draft deals three cards and you keep one, and it bends the rules for the round ahead. On a voyage that keeps a larder, this is also when the crew eats a ration a head.
guides.053.zh: 一轮的开场：发三张机缘，你留一张，接下来的规矩会偏向你一点。带粮舱的航程，也是船员每人吃一份口粮的时候。

guides.054.en: The round's trading floor. Captains post barter offers and take each other's here, and the table's votes (a manifest audit, a maroon) are called here too.
guides.054.zh: 一轮的交易场。船长们在这里挂出易货报价、彼此接手；桌上的表决（舱单稽查、放逐）也从这里发起。

guides.055.en: The round's reckoning. Production lands first, then pirates may strike, and then the wages, maintenance and taxes come due. The Dues tab is the list of what this phase will ask for.
guides.055.zh: 一轮的结算：先落产出，再是海盗可能来犯，然后工钱、维护费和税一起到期。港务费页签列的，就是这一步会上门的账。

guides.056.en: The round's last phase and the shipyard's seat: upgrade the hull, or draft and rig a module.
guides.056.zh: 一轮的最后一步，轮到船坞：升级船体，或者抽取并装上一件模块。

guides.057.en: What this captain owes at the round end: the crew's wages and the ship's upkeep in one total, with any outstanding loans listed underneath. This tab keeps the running count.
guides.057.zh: 这位船长轮末欠的账：船员工钱和船只维护合成一个总数，下面列着未还的借款。这个页签一直记着数。

guides.058.en: The cargo hold: the goods stowed aboard, one slot per unit of cargo, plus the crew that works them. This tab lists it all.
guides.058.zh: 货舱：船上装着的货物，一件货占一个仓位，还有干活的船员。这个页签把它们都列出来。

guides.059.en: The pantry half of the hold: the foods aboard, measured in slots. The Larder counts the meals inside them.
guides.059.zh: 货舱里伙房那半边：存着的食物，按仓位算。粮舱数的就是里面的餐数。

guides.060.en: The meals aboard for the crew, one ration a head eaten at each Dawn. Run it dry and the crew works hungry, and a long stretch without rations costs a hand.
guides.060.zh: 船上给船员备的餐，每个破晓每人吃一份。吃空了，船员就饿着干活；连着太久断粮，要折损一名人手。

guides.061.en: The broker's cut on a Broker's Favor order: a share of the reward, paid when the order fills. The card prints the cut before you fill it.
guides.061.zh: 掮客在人情订单里抽的那份：报酬的一部分，订单成交时付。接单前，牌面就写明抽多少。

guides.062.en: Gold or goods held aside the moment an offer, a pledge or a barter is posted, until the deal settles. Held goods cannot be spent or traded meanwhile, and they come back whole if the deal is canceled or expires.
guides.062.zh: 挂单、作保或易货一出手就寄存起来的金币或货，直到交易落定。寄存期间不能花用、不能转手；交易取消或过期，原样归还。

guides.064.en: went into the cold short of warm clothes
guides.064.zh: 没带够御寒衣物就进了寒程

guides.065.en: A warmer layer before a cold leg keeps every hand working
guides.065.zh: 寒程出发前添一层御寒衣物，人人照常开工

guides.067.en: the crew is on short rations

guides.070.en: no task is set for this leg

guides.071.en: Assign a task to put them to work
guides.071.zh: 派一件活，他们就能开工

guides.073.en: ❌ The only free hands are frozen out this leg: the crew {FROZEN_CREW.cause}, and they are back next leg. {FROZEN_CREW.remedy}.
guides.073.zh: ❌ 仅有的空闲人手本航段冻停了：船员{FROZEN_CREW.cause}，下个航段就回来。{FROZEN_CREW.remedy}。

guides.074.en: 🥶 {name} is frozen out this leg: the crew {FROZEN_CREW.cause}, and the work on {task} waits for next leg. {FROZEN_CREW.remedy}.
guides.074.zh: 🥶 {name}本航段冻停了：船员{FROZEN_CREW.cause}，{task}的活要等下一个航段。{FROZEN_CREW.remedy}。

guides.075.en: 🥶 Frostbite: {name} the {label} {FROZEN_CREW.cause}, and is out of action next leg. {FROZEN_CREW.remedy}.
guides.075.zh: 🥶 冻伤：{name}，这位{label}{FROZEN_CREW.cause}，下个航段不能出工。{FROZEN_CREW.remedy}。

guides.077.en: {reading}, so the cold will take a hand. {FROZEN_CREW.remedy}.

guides.078.en: {reading}, and the crew is dressed for it.

guides.079.en: legs in a row without rations costs the newest hand aboard.
guides.079.zh: 个航段连续断粮，会折损船上最新的人手。

guides.082.en: {IDLE_HAND.state}{skillMark}: {IDLE_HAND.cause}, and the wage is still owed at Resolve. {IDLE_HAND.remedy}.

guides.083.en: ⭐ Skilled: a trained hand makes 2 goods a round where an untrained one makes 1.
guides.083.zh: ⭐ 熟练：练过的人手每轮做2件，没练过的做1件。

guides.084.en: Going hungry: {HUNGRY_CREW.cause}, every artisan working at a slower pace, a quarter of the hold closed, and {hungryEffect} {HUNGRY_CREW.remedy} at the next Market.
guides.084.zh: 挨饿中：{HUNGRY_CREW.cause}，每位工匠干活都变慢，四分之一货舱封闭；{hungryEffect}下次开市时{HUNGRY_CREW.remedy}。

guides.085.en: The larder is empty: {HUNGRY_CREW.cause}, so every artisan produces less, a quarter of the hold is closed, and {hungryEffect} {HUNGRY_CREW.remedy} before the next Dawn.
guides.085.zh: 粮舱空了：{HUNGRY_CREW.cause}，每位工匠产出更少，四分之一货舱封闭；{hungryEffect}下次破晓前{HUNGRY_CREW.remedy}。

guides.086.en: ⚠️ The crew is on short rations, so every artisan works the leg at a slower pace, and {hungryEffect} {HUNGRY_CREW.remedy} at the next Market.
guides.086.zh: ⚠️ 船员吃着减半口粮，每位工匠本航段干活更慢；{hungryEffect}下次开市时{HUNGRY_CREW.remedy}。

manual.005.en: Captains gather in a shared harbor. The host picks a difficulty and sets sail. Everyone then plays the same voyage in lockstep: nobody advances a phase until every still active captain has readied up.
manual.005.zh: 船长们聚在同一个港湾。港主定下难度就启航，所有人走同一个航程、同进同退：只要还有船长在场，就得等大家都就绪，阶段才往前走。

manual.006.en: You can start a Solo Practice Voyage alone to learn the ropes without waiting for a second captain.
manual.006.zh: 不等第二位船长也可以：自己开一段单人练习航程，先把门道摸熟。

manual.007.en: Each round opens with a boon draft. Pick one of {CARDS_PER_OFFER} boons that bend the rules for the coming round: cheaper purchases, faster production, a tax shelter, or an emergency loan of {EMERGENCY_LOAN_GOLD} Gold.
manual.007.zh: 每轮开局先抽机缘。从{CARDS_PER_OFFER}张里挑一张，这一轮的规矩就偏向你：采购更便宜、生产更快、避一笔税，或是一笔{EMERGENCY_LOAN_GOLD}金币的紧急钱庄。

manual.008.en: You can swap your boon choices once per round for {BOON_SWAP_COST} Gold if none of the three fit your strategy.
manual.008.zh: 三张都不合你的打法，每轮还能花{BOON_SWAP_COST}金币把机缘换一次。

manual.009.en: Market is the port. Buy raw materials like Hemp, Silk, and Tea from the port merchant. Prices vary per captain and per round. You can also pay {INTEL_COST} Gold for a Broker's Rumor that guarantees a matching order appears when Orders opens.
manual.009.zh: 开市就在港口。向港口商人采购麻布、丝绸、茶叶这些原材料。价格每位船长各不同，每轮也在变。还可以花{INTEL_COST}金币买一条掮客密语，保证订单一开就有对得上的单子出现。

manual.010.en: The harbor remembers what everyone bought. A good the harbor leans into gets pricier next round, while one nobody touches softens.
manual.010.zh: 港湾记得每个人买过什么。大家都在买的货下一轮更贵，无人问津的会便宜下来。

manual.011.en: At the Parley you can trade goods and Gold directly with the other captains, whether your voyage runs it before the orders or after them. Post an offer of what you have and what you want, or accept an offer someone else posted. Offered goods are escrowed the moment you post.
manual.011.zh: 在洽谈，你可以和其他船长直接易货、换金币，不论航程把洽谈排在订单前还是后。挂出你有的、写明你想要的，或者接下别人挂的。货一挂出就寄存，直到成交或取消。

manual.012.en: You can target a specific captain with a Direct Barter Offer if you want to trade with only them. The Markets station of the Parley holds {held}.
manual.012.zh: 只想和某一位船长做买卖，可以发一份定向易货给他。洽谈的集市站里，开着{held}。

manual.013.en: Orders deals the trade manifest. Each entry asks for a set of goods and pays Gold and Reputation. Finished product orders pay more but require artisans to craft them first. The Emperor may also issue a Mandate, a high value order identical for every captain.
manual.013.zh: 订单阶段发舱单。每条写明要什么货，付你金币和声誉。成品订单给得更多，先得让工匠做出来。皇帝还可能下皇命：一张高价值订单，每位船长收到的都一样。

manual.014.en: Raw material orders are the safe early play. Finished product orders are where the real Reputation lives.
manual.014.zh: 原材料订单是前期的稳妥之选，大笔声誉都在成品订单里。

manual.015.en: Resolve is where the round's bills land. First, pirates may find you and take every Gold coin on hand. Hire an escort to sail safe, or risk it. Then pay wages and ship maintenance, and check the Dues tab of your captain's rail before you spend anything.
manual.015.zh: 结算就是本轮账单到期的时候。海盗可能先找上门，把你在手的金币卷走：雇护航求平安，或者赌一把。接着是工钱和船只维护费。花钱之前，先看一眼船长栏里的港务费页签。

manual.016.en: When other captains are aboard, ask the harbor for a loan before assuming the voyage is over. Any captain can lend, and a third captain can back the loan as a safety net.
manual.016.zh: 有其他船长在船上时，别急着断定航程结束，先向港湾借一笔。任何船长都能放款，第三位船长还能为这笔借款作保，兜一道底。

manual.017.en: Dusk is the shipyard. Upgrade your ship (opens a new module slot and reduces transport costs) or draft and rig a module. Modules are permanent ship upgrades: a Smuggler's Hold, a Broker's Network, a Salvage Crane, and more.
manual.017.zh: 暮色一到，船坞开门。升级船只（多开一个模块槽位，运费也更低），或者抽一个模块装上。模块是永久的船只升级：走私暗舱、掮客人脉、打捞起重机，还有更多。

manual.018.en: Do not skip the Shipyard. The transport discount from a higher ship level pays for itself within two rounds.
manual.018.zh: 别跳过船坞。船只等级升上去，省下的运费两轮就回本。

manual.020.en: Every voyage's final Reputation becomes Renown XP, multiplied by the difficulty tier. Renown levels grant titles, a small starting Gold bonus, and at level {BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL} unlock the Broker's Favor. The captain with the highest Reputation in a voyage is crowned Sea Master.
manual.020.zh: 每航程结束时的声誉都会变成声望经验，再按难度加成。声望等级给你称号和一小笔初始金币；到{BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL}级，解锁掮客的人情。一段航程里声誉最高的船长，加冕沧海之主。

manual.021.en: Check in daily for a seven day cycle of Renown XP rewards. It is not a streak, so a missed day never resets your progress.
manual.021.zh: 每天来看看，七天一轮的声望经验奖励。不用连签，漏一天也不会重置进度。

manual.023.en: Everything else is the voyage you would sail in Classic, so the rest of this manual reads the same for both.
manual.023.zh: 其余部分就是经典模式里的那次航程，这本手册剩下的内容两种模式通用。

manual.024.en: This is the voyage every other mode is measured against, and the one the rest of these pages describe.
manual.024.zh: 其他模式都以本航程为参照，后面几页也都在讲它。

manual.025.en: Hire weavers, potters, coppersmiths, and other artisans, then assign each a product to craft. Production does not happen instantly: a task assigned now delivers at this round's Resolve, after Orders has already closed.
manual.025.zh: 雇下织女、陶匠、铜匠这些工匠，再给每人派一件活。产出不是立刻的：这一轮派下的活，要到结算才交货，那时订单早已截止。

manual.026.en: A dealing voyage opens with a card deal rather than a market. Three cards land face down, and at each beat you keep one and pass the rest on: what you hold at the end is your path for the voyage, and one change of papers is allowed: at a port, for a fee in Gold that grows with your Renown. Your path decides your hold, how far your Renown can climb, and which trade orders lock to you.
manual.026.zh: 发牌航程以发牌开局，而不是开市。三张牌背面朝上落下，一路留一张、传走其余：最后留在手上的，就是你这趟的商道。商道可以换一次：在港口花一笔金币，价格随声望涨。商道定下你的货舱、声望能爬多高，以及哪些订单只认你这条道。

manual.027.en: Weigh the numbers under each name rather than the crest. The five paths trade different holds, Renown ceilings and locked order pools, and the one you keep sails with you to the end.
manual.027.zh: 看名字下面的数字，而不是徽记。五条商道的货舱、声望上限和专属订单各不相同；留下哪条，它陪你走到航程尽头。

manual.062.en: You can target a specific captain with a Direct Barter Offer if you want to trade with only them.
manual.062.zh: 只想和某一位船长做买卖，可以发一份定向易货给他。

manual.030.en: Shortcuts are ignored while typing in inputs or text areas.
manual.030.zh: 在输入框或文本区打字时，快捷键不起作用。

manual.037.en: The Harbormaster is fetching the tide tables.

manual.041.en: Keep your purse above maintenance plus all wages, and hire artisans only when you can sustain them.
manual.041.zh: 手头的金币要始终高过维护费加全部工钱；养得起，再雇工匠。

manual.050.en: Need at least one captain in the harbor
manual.050.zh: 港湾里至少需要一位船长

manual.051.en: The New Captain Tutorial lists everything this mode changes.
manual.051.zh: 新船长教程列出了这个模式改动的全部内容。

manual.052.en: Starting resources, round costs, taxes and the pirate odds.
manual.052.zh: 开局资源、轮末开销、税负和海盗概率。

manual.053.en: Assign task now → item arrives at Resolve
manual.053.zh: 现在派活 → 结算时到货

manual.056.en: 👥 Wages settled at Resolve, not on hire
manual.056.zh: 👥 工钱在结算时付，不是在雇用时

manual.057.en: VAT: {vatPct}% of finished goods profit margin

manual.058.en: Hire an escort, or ask the harbor for a loan
manual.058.zh: 雇一艘护航，或者向港湾借一笔

descriptions.001.en: This harbor has already used its one Venture for this voyage. It opens again on a fresh voyage or a restart.
descriptions.001.zh: 这个港湾本航程唯一的一次合股机会，已经用掉了。等新开一次航程或重开，才会再有。

descriptions.002.en: ⚓ A Venture filled! Every contributor is paid their share, times {CONVOY_VENTURE_PAYOUT_MULTIPLIER}x. This harbor's one Venture chance for this voyage has now been used.
descriptions.002.zh: ⚓ 合股凑齐了！每位出资人都拿回自己那份，再乘 {CONVOY_VENTURE_PAYOUT_MULTIPLIER}倍。这个港湾本航程唯一的那次合股机会，到此用掉。

descriptions.003.en: ⚓ A Venture missed its deadline. Every contributor gets back a partial refund.
descriptions.003.zh: ⚓ 一笔合股的期限到了，没凑齐。每位出资人拿回部分退款。

descriptions.004.en: ⚓ A Venture was canceled: another venture in the harbor already claimed this voyage's one chance. Every contributor gets back their full stake.
descriptions.004.zh: ⚓ 一笔合股被取消：港湾里另一笔合股先占了本航程唯一的机会。每位出资人拿回全部本金。

descriptions.005.en: ⚰️ {gone.name} the {label} is lost after {CREW_LOSS_AFTER_HUNGRY_LEGS} legs on short rations, and nothing brings them back.
descriptions.005.zh: ⚰️ {gone.name}，这位{label}，在 {CREW_LOSS_AFTER_HUNGRY_LEGS}个航段的减半口粮之后没能撑住，再也回不来了。

descriptions.006.en: The {gone.task} they were working is lost with them.

descriptions.007.en: 🌊 There is no one left aboard.

descriptions.009.en: ❌ Need {amount} Gold to back that Venture, have {state.money}
descriptions.009.zh: ❌ 为这笔合股作保要 {amount}金币，你手头只有 {state.money}

descriptions.010.zh: ⚓ 用{amount}金币给一笔合股作了保

descriptions.012.en: ⚓ Venture missed its deadline. Partial refund: {amount} Gold
descriptions.012.zh: ⚓ 一笔合股的期限到了，没凑齐。部分退款：{amount}金币

descriptions.013.en: ⚓ Venture canceled: another venture in the harbor already claimed this voyage's one chance. Full refund: {amount} Gold
descriptions.013.zh: ⚓ 一笔合股被取消：港湾里另一笔合股先占了本航程唯一的机会。全额退款：{amount}金币

descriptions.014.en: 🧭 Dawn: Draft a Boon → 📦 Market: Buy at Ports → 🤝 Parley: Barter → 📜 Orders: Fill Trade Orders → 💸 Resolve: Pirates, Wages & Maintenance → 🚢 Dusk: Upgrade Ship
descriptions.014.zh: 🧭 破晓：抽机缘 → 📦 开市：港口采购 → 🤝 洽谈：易货 → 📜 订单：交付贸易订单 → 💸 结算：海盗、工钱与维护费 → 🚢 暮色：升级船只

descriptions.015.en: Fall short on the bills and the voyage is over for that captain: the bankruptcy screen is the last of it, and the standings are read without them.
descriptions.015.zh: 账单付不出来，这位船长的航程就到头了：破产画面是最后一站，排名不再把他算在内。

descriptions.016.en: Three boons are dealt to you alone each round: cheaper buying, fuller workshops, a shelter from the tax, or a loan when the purse runs thin.
descriptions.016.zh: 每轮只发给你一个人的三张机缘：买得更便宜、工坊出得更多、躲开一笔税，或钱袋见底时的一笔借款。

descriptions.017.en: The one you take bends this round and no other, so read the rest of the round before you choose.
descriptions.017.zh: 留下的那一张只作用本轮，所以先把本轮剩下的安排看完再选。

descriptions.018.en: Load the hold at the port market and set each artisan a task. Prices shift every round, every captain is quoted their own, and wages fall due working or idle.
descriptions.018.zh: 在集市装满货舱，给每位工匠派一件活。价格每轮都在变，每位船长拿到的报价都不一样，工钱干不干活都照付。

descriptions.019.en: What the artisans make lands at settlement, so their work answers the next manifest rather than the one you are about to fill.
descriptions.019.zh: 工匠做出来的货到结算才落舱，所以他们赶的是下一张舱单，不是你手上正要交的这张。

descriptions.020.en: The manifest deals and you commit: goods for Gold and Reputation, and nothing on the sheet can be revised once the fleet starts talking.
descriptions.020.zh: 舱单一发，你就落定：货换金币和声誉；等船队开始议价，单子上的字一个也改不了。

descriptions.021.en: The fleet cannot see what you committed, which cuts both ways: your round stays hidden from them, and theirs from you.
descriptions.021.zh: 船队看不到你交了什么，反过来也一样：你的这一轮对他们保密，他们的对你也保密。

descriptions.022.en: The Captain's Exchange opens. Post what you can spare and name your price, or take what another captain has already set on the table.
descriptions.022.zh: 船长行市开了。挂出你富余的东西、标上你的价，或者接下别的船长已经摆上桌的。

descriptions.023.en: A majority of the fleet can open one captain's manifest from this table, and calling it spends the rest of the table's trading.
descriptions.023.zh: 船队多数可以从这张桌上翻开一位船长的舱单；发起表决，这一场交易剩下的时间就没了。

descriptions.024.en: Pirates roll for every coin aboard. An escort buys the safe passage for a cut of what you carry, so the fee is cheapest exactly when you have the least to protect.
descriptions.024.zh: 海盗盯上船上的每一枚钱。护航按你随身金币的比例抽成，替你买下平安通行；所以你身上金币越少，这笔钱反倒越便宜。

descriptions.025.en: Then the wages and the ship's maintenance come due, and what survives the bills is what you take to the yard.
descriptions.025.zh: 然后工钱和船只维护到期，扛过账单剩下多少，你就带多少去船坞。

descriptions.026.en: Spend what survived: a level of hull carries another module slot and cuts the cost of every haul, and a drafted module is bolted on for good.
descriptions.026.zh: 花掉留下来的金币：船体升一级多一个模块槽位，还砍低每一趟的运费；抽到的模块装上就永久生效。

descriptions.027.en: What you spend here is what the next round's port cannot be bought with.
descriptions.027.zh: 在这里花掉的，下一轮开市就买不回货了。

descriptions.028.en: The round closes at the yard and opens again at the ports, with whatever this one left in the hold.
descriptions.028.zh: 一轮在船坞合上，又在港口打开，带着这一轮留在货舱里的东西。

descriptions.029.en: No captain leaves the table here. Fall short on the bills and the harbor marks it against you for the rest of the voyage, and you sail on with your card, your vote and your say at the table.
descriptions.029.zh: 没有船长在这里离席。账单付不出，港湾会在剩下的航程里一直记着这笔账；你带着牌、票和桌上的发言权，继续往前走。

descriptions.030.en: The manifest closes before the table opens: Orders runs ahead of Parley, so you commit to your sheet first and nothing on it can be revised once the fleet starts talking.
descriptions.030.zh: 舱单先行，桌面后开：订单排在洽谈之前，所以你先对单子落定，船队一开口议价，单子上的内容就不能再改。

descriptions.031.en: Every voyage here runs 12 rounds, whatever tier you sail. That is the length the harbor's two votes are tuned to.
descriptions.031.zh: 这里的航程不论难度，都走12轮。港湾的两次表决就是照这个长度调的。

descriptions.032.en: Every captain is dealt a private card when the voyage leaves the dock, and no one else can see it: most are Honest Captains sailing the fleet's public objective, while a table of four or more hides a Pirate in the fleet and a table of six or more may hide a Broker beside them. Every card turns face up when the voyage ends.
descriptions.032.zh: 航程离港时，每位船长都发到一张别人看不到的私牌：多数是诚信船长，跟着船队的公开目标走；四人以上的桌上，船队里藏着一个海盗，六人以上还可能多藏一个掮客。航程结束时，所有牌都翻开。

descriptions.033.en: From round 5, a simple majority of the fleet can open one captain's manifest at a Parley. The room is shown 2 of that captain's last 5 fills, and calling the vote spends the rest of that Parley's trading.
descriptions.033.zh: 从第5轮起，船队过半数可以在洽谈时翻开一位船长的舱单。港湾会看到那位船长最近5笔交货中的2笔；发起这次表决，那场洽谈剩下的交易时间就没了。

descriptions.034.en: From round 9, two thirds of the captains still sailing can vote one captain ashore, once a voyage. The ship and its hold go to the harbor, half that captain's Gold stays aboard, and they take up the Harbormaster's hand: once a round, they name a port and lean every price there 10 percent either way.
descriptions.034.zh: 从第9轮起，仍在航程中的船长凑够三分之二，就能投票把一位船长放逐上岸，每趟航程一次。船和舱里的货归港湾，他一半的金币留在船上；此后他接过港务长之手：每轮一次，点一座港口，把那儿的物价往任意一边拨动10%。

engine.002.en: A majority is more than half of the captains still in the voyage.
engine.002.zh: 仍在航程中的船长里，超过一半才算多数。

engine.008.en: Backing another captain's loan pays extra Renown while this Age holds the harbor.
engine.008.zh: 时代执掌港湾期间，为其他船长的借款作保，多得声望。

engine.010.en: Every completed barter trade lands one extra Reputation on top of the goods changing hands.
engine.010.zh: 每成交一笔易货，除货物易手，还多得1点声誉。

engine.012.en: The Broker's Favor commission cap is raised to 250 Gold, so a single favor can pay out more than usual.
engine.012.zh: 掮客的人情进账上限提到250金币，一次人情比平时给得更多。

engine.013.en: 🤝 No Reputation this time: you have already earned this voyage's full {cap} for helping other captains.
engine.013.zh: 🤝 这次没有声誉：本航程帮其他船长的{cap}点，你已经拿满。

engine.311.en: 🆘 {loan.fromName} lent you {loan.amount} Gold. Repay it before the voyage ends, or it's deducted automatically.
engine.311.zh: 🆘 {loan.fromName}借给你{loan.amount}金币。航程结束前还清，不然会被自动扣还。

engine.312.en: 🤝 Lent {loan.borrowerName} {loan.amount} Gold. Reputation +{repGain} for helping a fellow captain.
engine.312.zh: 🤝 借给{loan.borrowerName}{loan.amount}金币。帮了同席船长，声誉 +{repGain}。

engine.316.en: ⚠️ Could not fully repay {debt.counterpartyName}: paid {paid} of {debt.amount} Gold owed

engine.015.en: ❌ Need {amount} Gold to back that loan, have {state.money}
engine.015.zh: ❌ 为这笔借款作保要{amount}金币，现有{state.money}

engine.016.en: 🛡️ Pledged {amount} Gold to back a fellow captain's loan
engine.016.zh: 🛡️ 质押{amount}金币，为同席船长的借款作保

engine.017.en: ⚖️ Age of the Lender: a pledge that comes home whole pays {pledgeBonusPct}% more while it holds the harbor.
engine.017.zh: ⚖️ 债主之年：时代执掌港湾期间，质押完好收回，多付{pledgeBonusPct}%。

engine.318.en: 🛡️ Your backing was never called on. Pledge returned in full: {refundAmount} Gold. Reputation +{repGain} for the risk paying off.
engine.318.zh: 🛡️ 你的作保没有被动用，质押全额退回：{refundAmount}金币。风险有了回报，声誉 +{repGain}。

engine.319.en: 🛡️ Your backing was never called on. Pledge returned in full: {refundAmount} Gold.
engine.319.zh: 🛡️ 你的作保没有被动用，质押全额退回：{refundAmount}金币。

engine.320.en: 🛡️ Your backing partially covered a captain's shortfall: {calledAmount} Gold spent, {refundAmount} Gold returned.
engine.320.zh: 🛡️ 你的作保补上了一位船长缺口的一部分：花去{calledAmount}金币，退回{refundAmount}金币。

engine.018.en: ⚓ No crew aboard, so there is nothing to provision.
engine.018.zh: ⚓ 船上没有船员，不用备粮。

engine.019.en: ⛵ The barge has nothing left for you this leg.
engine.019.zh: ⛵ 本航段驳船没有余量给你了。

engine.020.en: ❌ Name how many rations to buy from the barge.
engine.020.zh: ❌ 请写明从驳船买多少份口粮。

engine.021.en: ❌ The barge charges {price} Gold a ration, and the purse cannot cover one.
engine.021.zh: ❌ 驳船一份口粮要{price}金币，钱袋连一份也付不起。

engine.022.en: ⛵ The barge takes {cost} Gold for {wanted} {rationWord} of grain. {rationsLeft} left for you this leg.
engine.022.zh: ⛵ 驳船收{cost}金币，卖你{wanted}份米粮。本航段还给你剩{rationsLeft}份。

engine.023.en: ⚖️ Age of the Trader: +{gain} Reputation for the completed trade.
engine.023.zh: ⚖️ 商贾之年：这笔易货成交，声誉 +{gain}。

engine.024.en: ❌ Can't barter an item for itself
engine.024.zh: ❌ 不能拿同一种货换它自己。

engine.025.en: ❌ Barter amounts must be whole numbers of at least 1
engine.025.zh: ❌ 易货数量得是整数，至少1。

engine.026.en: swept when the voyage moved on

engine.030.en: A rumor is priced by the port one leg after the leg it was spoken in, and this is the last leg of the voyage, so a rumor spoken here would move nothing.
engine.030.zh: 风声要等开口后的那个航段，港口才给它定价。这是本航程最后一个航段，在这里开口，什么也拨不动。

engine.031.en: The bazaar is quiet for you to the end of this voyage. You spoke in leg {spoke}.
engine.031.zh: 本航程结束之前，香市都不会再听你开口。你开口是在第{spoke}航段。

engine.032.en: The bazaar will hear you again.

engine.033.en: The bazaar is quiet for you for one more leg.
engine.033.zh: 香市还要对你静一个航段。

engine.034.en: The bazaar is quiet for you for {left} more legs.
engine.034.zh: 香市还要对你静{left}个航段。

engine.035.en: The port of leg {leg} drew {row.good} and priced it against your rumor.
engine.035.zh: 第{leg}航段的港口抽到了{row.good}，按你的风声给它定了价。

engine.036.en: The port of leg {leg} drew no {row.good}, so your rumor moved no price you could buy.
engine.036.zh: 第{leg}航段的港口没有抽到{row.good}，你的风声没有拨动任何你能买到的价格。

engine.037.en: {row.good}: every price {percent} percent {way} at the next port

engine.308.en: {good}: every price {percent} percent higher at the next port

engine.309.en: {good}: every price {percent} percent lower at the next port

engine.039.en: ❌ Need {cost} Gold to upgrade the ship

engine.041.zh: ❌ 没有空槽位了！得换掉一个。

engine.043.en: Choose a Boon to bend the rules of the upcoming voyage...
engine.043.zh: 选一份机缘，为接下来的航程改一改规矩...

engine.044.en: ❌ You've already swapped your boon choices this round
engine.044.zh: ❌ 本轮你已经换过机缘了

engine.045.en: ❌ Need {BOON_SWAP_COST} Gold to swap boon choices

engine.047.en: ❌ You've already swapped your module choices this round
engine.047.zh: ❌ 本轮你已经换过模块了

engine.048.en: ❌ Nothing to swap, draft your modules first
engine.048.zh: ❌ 没有可换的，先抽取模块

engine.049.en: ❌ The yard has nothing new to deal this hull: every module it could offer is either aboard or already on the table. Take one of these, sell one at the table, or come back next leg.
engine.049.zh: ❌ 船坞没有新货能给这艘船体了：它拿得出来的模块，要么已经在船上，要么已经摆在桌上。从这些里挑一个，或者到桌上卖掉一个，要么下个航段再来。

engine.050.en: 🔄 Swapped Module Choices for a fresh batch

engine.051.en: ❌ That seat is no longer on your hull, so there is nothing there to replace. Back to Draft and take the card again: the yard fits it to the hull as it stands.
engine.051.zh: ❌ 那个槽位已经不在你的船体上，那里没有可切换的东西。回到抽取，重新拿一次牌：船坞会按船体现在的样子装上它。

engine.330.en: 🎉 Ship Upgraded to Level {state.shipLevel}! +1 Module Slot, +{SHIP_DISCOUNT_PER_LEVEL} Discount
engine.330.zh: 🎉 船升级到{state.shipLevel}级！模块槽位 +1，折扣 +{SHIP_DISCOUNT_PER_LEVEL}

engine.333.en: The books ran out mid voyage, and {input.displayName} sailed the rest of it bankrupt.
engine.333.zh: 航程走到一半，账上见了底，{input.displayName}破产跑完了剩下的路。

engine.056.en: 🛡️ Raiders meant for {who} met your guns: your hold lost {ate} Gold.
engine.056.zh: 🛡️ 冲{who}去的海盗撞上了你的炮口：货舱损失{ate}金币。

engine.057.en: 🛡️ Raiders meant for {who} met your guns and found your hold already bare.
engine.057.zh: 🛡️ 冲{who}去的海盗撞上了你的炮口，只见你的货舱早已空了。

engine.334.en: 🤝 Escort contract: paid {paid} Gold to {contract.sellerName} for one leg of protection.
engine.334.zh: 🤝 护航契约：花{paid}金币，向{contract.sellerName}买一航段的保护。

engine.335.en: 🤝 Escort contract: {buyerName} paid {contract.fee} Gold for one leg of protection.
engine.335.zh: 🤝 护航契约：{buyerName}花{contract.fee}金币，买下一航段的保护。

engine.058.zh: 📜 作废{count}份未交付的商道订单。

engine.059.en: The harbor reads new papers from round {PATH_SWITCH_FROM_ROUND}.
engine.059.zh: 港湾从第{PATH_SWITCH_FROM_ROUND}轮起才收新文书。

engine.060.en: The window for new papers closed after round {PATH_SWITCH_TO_ROUND}.
engine.060.zh: 第{PATH_SWITCH_TO_ROUND}轮之后，换新文书的窗口就关了。

engine.061.en: A captain changes their papers once a voyage, and yours are already changed.
engine.061.zh: 船长一程只能换一次文书，你的已经换过了。

engine.062.en: You hold no path to set aside.
engine.062.zh: 你手上没有可以搁下的商道。

engine.063.zh: 你已经握着那条商道了。

engine.064.en: ❌ Need {fee} Gold to change your papers.

engine.065.en: 🏛️ No profit, no income tax due
engine.065.zh: 🏛️ 没有盈利，不用缴所得税

engine.075.en: 🚢 Sail across ports, build your business empire!
engine.075.zh: 🚢 扬帆走遍各个港口，开创你的商业帝国！

engine.076.en: 👥 Hire artisans to craft valuable goods for higher profits!
engine.076.zh: 👥 雇工匠，做出贵重货物，赚更高的利润！

engine.078.en: 🌊 Tidewatch Alert: the harbor takes notice of a bustling crew! One more cargo lot joins the Port Purchase board, every round, for the rest of this voyage.
engine.078.zh: 🌊 观潮预警：港湾瞧见船队忙起来了！本航程余下的每一轮，港口采购板上都会多出一件货物。

engine.079.en: ❌ Insufficient funds! Need {cost} Gold, Have {state.money} Gold
engine.079.zh: ❌ 资金不足！要{cost}金币，现有{state.money}金币

engine.080.en: ❌ No room in the hold for that lot: it takes {units} {slotWord} and {room} {beWord} free.
engine.080.zh: ❌ 货舱放不下这件货：它要占{units}个仓位，空着{room}个。

engine.082.en: 💡 Tip: VAT applies when selling finished products
engine.082.zh: 💡 提示：卖出成品要缴增值税

engine.345.en: 🛒 Bought Product at {card.port}: {icon}{type}×{quantity} (@{price} Gold/item, Mat Cost {matCost} Gold), Total {cost} Gold
engine.345.zh: 🛒 在{card.port}买下成品：{icon}{type}×{quantity}（@{price}金币/件，材料成本{matCost}金币），合计{cost}金币

engine.346.zh: ✨ 机缘折扣生效！省下{saved}金币

engine.348.en: 🗺️ The Silk Road Charter opens! The harbor grows busier: {tierPurchaseCount} cargo lots and as many buyers from this voyage on.
engine.348.zh: 🗺️ 丝路特许状开启！港湾更热闹了：从本航程起，货物多出{tierPurchaseCount}件，买家也一样多。

engine.089.en: ❌ The yard has no {name} to bolt on.

engine.351.en: 🤝 Module trade: paid {paid} Gold to {trade.sellerName} for {name}.

engine.090.en: 📜 The commission is already filled, and nothing was taken.
engine.090.zh: 📜 公议已经交齐，没有取走任何东西。

engine.091.en: 📜 Nothing in the hold answers the commission.
engine.091.zh: 📜 货舱里没有公议要的东西。

engine.093.en: 📜 Fleet Commission: delivered {partList} for {paid} Gold. The Emperor's commission is exempt from VAT.
engine.093.zh: 📜 船队公议：交付{partList}，得{paid}金币。皇命采办免缴增值税。

engine.096.en: 🎭 Your borrow is spent, and the order stays locked.
engine.096.zh: 🎭 你的借用已经用完，这份订单仍然锁定。

engine.369.en: {lead}: {payout} Gold instead of {reward}. One order filled without joining the path.
engine.369.zh: {lead}：拿{payout}金币，而不是{reward}。不入商道也完成一单。

engine.099.en: 💰 Reward: {reward} Gold · ⚓ Freight: {transport} Gold = 📊 Net Profit: {netProfit} Gold
engine.099.zh: 💰 报酬：{reward}金币 · ⚓ 运费：{transport}金币 = 📊 净利：{netProfit}金币

engine.100.en: 📣 Word on the Docks: you were first to complete {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD} trade orders this voyage! +{WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_REWARD} Gold
engine.100.zh: 📣 码头风闻：本航程头一个交足{WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD}笔贸易订单的是你！+{WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_REWARD}金币

engine.101.en: ❌ Broker's Favor unlocks at Renown Level {BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL}
engine.101.zh: ❌ 掮客的人情要到声望等级{BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL}才解锁

engine.102.en: ❌ You've already called in a Broker's Favor this voyage
engine.102.zh: ❌ 本航程你已经用过一次掮客的人情

engine.103.en: ❌ The Broker can't find a buyer for {item}
engine.103.zh: ❌ 掮客找不到愿意买{item}的买家

engine.104.en: ❌ You have no {item} in the hold for the Broker to sell
engine.104.zh: ❌ 货舱里没有{item}可以让掮客出手

engine.105.en: ❌ Choose between 1 and {held} {item} for the Broker to sell
engine.105.zh: ❌ 掮客出手的{item}，1到{held}件之间选。

engine.107.en: 🔮 The Broker only deals during Market.
engine.107.zh: 🔮 掮客只在开市时做生意。

engine.108.en: 🔮 The Broker has no more whispers...

engine.110.en: 🗣️ Broker's Whisper: 'Word from {port}: High demand for {item}!'

engine.111.en: 📜 Imperial Mandate at {mandate.port}: {need} for {mandate.reward} Gold. The Emperor's commission is exempt from VAT.
engine.111.zh: 📜 {mandate.port}的皇命采办：要{need}，得{mandate.reward}金币。皇命采办免缴增值税。

engine.114.en: 🏴‍☠️ Pirates raided your hold! Lost all {lost} Gold.
engine.114.zh: 🏴‍☠️ 海盗劫掠了你的货舱！{lost}金币全部损失。

engine.115.en: 🌊 Clear seas. No pirates sighted this round.
engine.115.zh: 🌊 海面平静。本轮没有发现海盗。

engine.116.en: ❌ Too late, this round's waters are already resolved
engine.116.zh: ❌ 太迟了，本轮的海面已经结算

engine.117.en: 🛡️ Hired an escort for {cost} Gold. Safe passage guaranteed this round.
engine.117.zh: 🛡️ 花{cost}金币雇了护航。本轮航路安全无虞。

engine.357.en: 🏴‍☠️ Pirates raided your hold! Lost all {lost} Gold, and {lead} recovered {salvaged} of it.
engine.357.zh: 🏴‍☠️ 海盗劫掠了你的货舱！{lost}金币全没了，{lead}又替你追回{salvaged}金币。

engine.124.en: ❌ Only a Loom captain buys rags off the harbor pile.
engine.124.zh: ❌ 只有织造船长才从港湾的碎布堆里买碎布。

engine.125.en: ❌ The harbor has no rags left for you this leg.
engine.125.zh: ❌ 本航段港湾没有碎布留给你了。

engine.126.en: ❌ {RAG_SCRAP_VALUE} Gold buys a rag, and the purse is short.
engine.126.zh: ❌ 一块碎布要{RAG_SCRAP_VALUE}金币，钱袋不够。

engine.127.en: ❌ There is no room in the hold for another rag.
engine.127.zh: ❌ 货舱里放不下再多一块碎布了。

engine.128.en: {ICONS.Rags} Bought a rag off the harbor pile for {RAG_SCRAP_VALUE} Gold. {scrapsLeft} left for you this leg.
engine.128.zh: {ICONS.Rags} 花{RAG_SCRAP_VALUE}金币从港湾的碎布堆买了一块碎布。本航段还给你剩{scrapsLeft}块。

engine.129.en: ❌ Only a Loom captain knows how to work rags back into cloth.
engine.129.zh: ❌ 只有织造船长懂得把碎布重新织回布。

engine.130.en: ❌ A reweave takes {REWEAVE_RAGS} rags and the hold has fewer.
engine.130.zh: ❌ 重织一次要{REWEAVE_RAGS}块碎布，货舱里不够。

engine.131.en: 🧵 {REWEAVE_RAGS} rags go back on the loom and come off as one {REWEAVE_GOOD}.
engine.131.zh: 🧵 {REWEAVE_RAGS}块碎布回到织机上，下来就是一件{REWEAVE_GOOD}。

engine.132.en: ❌ That is not something the harbor can put right.

engine.133.en: ❌ The harbor tailors have already worked on the crew this leg.
engine.133.zh: ❌ 本航段港湾的裁缝已经给船员缝补过了。

engine.134.en: ❌ The crew is wearing no worn {good} for the harbor to mend.
engine.134.zh: ❌ 船员身上没有需要港湾缝补的破旧{good}。

engine.135.en: ❌ A mend costs {MEND_GOLD_PER_POINT} Gold and the purse is short.
engine.135.zh: ❌ 缝补一次要{MEND_GOLD_PER_POINT}金币，钱袋不够。

engine.136.en: {ICONS.Rags} The harbor tailor takes {MEND_GOLD_PER_POINT} Gold for {back} point of the {good}.
engine.136.zh: {ICONS.Rags} 港湾的裁缝收{MEND_GOLD_PER_POINT}金币，补回{good}的{back}点。

engine.137.en: ❌ There is no worn {contract.good} left to work on.
engine.137.zh: ❌ 没有还需要缝补的破旧{contract.good}了。

engine.366.en: 🤝 Refit: paid {paid} Gold to {seller} for the {good} to be put right.

engine.367.en: 🤝 Refit: {buyer} paid {fee} Gold for the {good} to be put right.

engine.138.en: 🏴 Bankrupt: the harbor marks it against this captain's name for the rest of the voyage.
engine.138.zh: 🏴 破产：本航程余下的时间里，港湾都会把这件事记在这位船长名下。

engine.139.en: 🏝️ The harbor has voted to maroon this captain.
engine.139.zh: 🏝️ 港湾已经投票把这位船长放逐上岸。

engine.140.en: ⚖️ The ship and its hold are forfeit. The harbor takes {taken} Gold and leaves {kept} Gold aboard.
engine.140.zh: ⚖️ 船和货舱一并没收。港湾取走{taken}金币，船上留下{kept}金币。

engine.141.en: 🧭 The Harbormaster's hand: once a leg, one port's prices answer to this captain.
engine.141.zh: 🧭 港务长之手：每航段一次，让某个港口的价格听命于这位船长。

engine.142.en: 🪧 Standing orders at the port board: bought {bought.length} cargo {lotWord} you had priced.
engine.142.zh: 🪧 港口采购板上的常备订单：买下了{bought.length}件你定过价的货物。

engine.143.en: 🪧 Standing orders at the trade board: filled {filled} {orderWord} the hold could cover.
engine.143.zh: 🪧 订单板上的常备订单：交付了{filled}份货舱供得上的订单。

engine.145.en: {workerIcon} Hired {identity.name} the {label}! Wage: {wage} Gold / Round (paid at round end)
engine.145.zh: {workerIcon} 雇下了{label}{identity.name}！工钱：每轮{wage}金币（轮末支付）

engine.146.en: 🪷 Jade Pavilion pledge honored: this artisan joins at no cost, so the first wage is on the House.
engine.146.zh: 🪷 玉阁的承诺兑现：这位工匠入伙不收钱，头一笔工钱也由玉阁代付。

engine.152.en: ❌ All workers are already assigned tasks!
engine.152.zh: ❌ 所有工匠都已经安排了活计！

engine.156.en: ⭐ {name} Promotion! Can now produce 2 items per round!

engine.157.en: 🪷 Jade Pavilion covers the wage for {b.sponsored} {bLabel} this round.
engine.157.zh: 🪷 本轮{b.sponsored}名{bLabel}的工钱由玉阁代付。

engine.159.en: ⚠️ Insufficient funds! Needed: {total} Gold, Have: {state.money} Gold
engine.159.zh: ⚠️ 资金不足！要{total}金币，现有{state.money}金币

engine.160.en: 💥 Could not pay wages, the crew is left unpaid.
engine.160.zh: 💥 付不出工钱，工匠这一轮白干。

engine.161.en: 💥 Reputation collapsed: a bankruptcy is recorded.
engine.161.zh: 💥 声誉崩塌：记下一次破产。

engine.164.en: ⚠️ Funds depleted: the maintenance fee goes unpaid.
engine.164.zh: ⚠️ 资金耗尽：维护费交不上。

engine.165.en: {foodIcon} {meals} {rationWord} of {food} turned at sea. {larderAfter} left in the larder.
engine.165.zh: {foodIcon} {meals}份{food}在海上变质了。粮舱还剩{larderAfter}份。

engine.166.en: ❌ Not enough Produce aboard to preserve: a batch is {PRESERVE_MEALS_IN} meals.
engine.166.zh: ❌ 船上的时鲜不够腌制：一批要{PRESERVE_MEALS_IN}份。

engine.167.en: 🐟 Preserved {taken} {rationWord} of Produce into {made} of Salt Fish ({state.larder} in the larder).
engine.167.zh: 🐟 把{taken}份时鲜腌成了{made}份咸鱼（粮舱里有{state.larder}份）。

engine.168.en: Finish the voyage holding at least {flourish.amount} Gold of your own.
engine.168.zh: 走完航程时，自己手上还留着至少{flourish.amount}金币。

engine.169.en: Finish the voyage at {flourish.amount} Reputation or better.
engine.169.zh: 走完航程时声誉达到{flourish.amount}或更高。

engine.170.en: Finish the voyage still holding {flourish.amount} {flourish.good} of your own.
engine.170.zh: 走完航程时，自己手上还留着{flourish.amount} {flourish.good}。

engine.171.en: Hand over at least {flourish.amount} items of the commission yourself.
engine.171.zh: 公议的货，你本人至少交出{flourish.amount}件。

engine.172.en: {name} sails the same flag you do, and the two of you know it.
engine.172.zh: {name}和你挂同一面旗，你们两人都清楚。

engine.174.en: You sail the public objective with the fleet. Nothing about you is hidden.
engine.174.zh: 你和船队同走公开的目标。你的一切，都摊在明面上。

engine.176.en: You sail under a false flag. The fleet's objective has to fail, and you have to stay solvent while it does.
engine.176.zh: 你挂着假旗航行。船队的目标得落空，落空之前，你还得撑着不破产。

engine.177.en: You sail for yourself, and only for yourself. Profit from deals with other captains, and the fleet's success is no loss to you.
engine.177.zh: 你为自己航行，只为自己。跟其他船长交易赚钱，船队成功也不亏你。

engine.178.en: ⚠️ Short rations! {crew} aboard and the larder is empty: the crew works this leg at {pace}% pace, and every line still brings home at least one item. The fleet can see it.
engine.178.zh: ⚠️ 减半口粮！船上{crew}人，粮舱已空：本航段船员按{pace}%的速度干活，每人仍至少带回一件。船队看得见。

engine.179.en: 🍲 The crew eats {need} {rationWord}. {state.larder} left in the larder.
engine.179.zh: 🍲 船员吃掉{need}份口粮。粮舱还剩{state.larder}份。

engine.181.en: ❌ Not enough Gold to provision the crew: a leg of rations is {cost} Gold.
engine.181.zh: ❌ 金币不够给船员备粮：一个航段的口粮要{cost}金币。

engine.182.en: 🧺 Provisioned {rations} {rationWord} of {food} for {crew} aboard ({cost} Gold). {state.larder} in the larder.
engine.182.zh: 🧺 给船上{crew}人备齐了口粮：{rations}份{food}，花了{cost}金币。粮舱里{state.larder}份。

engine.187.en: Get crowned Sea Master on a {monsoon.name} voyage.
engine.187.zh: 在{monsoon.name}的航程中加冕沧海之主。

engine.310.en: End a single voyage with {minScore}+ Reputation.

engine.190.en: This harbor was closed by the harbor operator.
engine.190.zh: 这个港湾已被港湾操作员关闭。

engine.191.en: This account was deleted by the harbor operator.
engine.191.zh: 这个账号已被港湾操作员删除。

engine.192.en: Sign in to use the operator console.
engine.192.zh: 登录后可使用操作员控制台。

engine.194.zh: 那个账号已经不存在了。

engine.195.en: You cannot ban your own account.
engine.195.zh: 不能封停你自己的账号。

engine.196.en: You cannot revoke your own administrator role.
engine.196.zh: 不能撤销你自己的管理员身份。

engine.197.en: This is the only administrator left, so the role cannot be revoked.
engine.197.zh: 这是最后一位管理员，身份不能撤销。

engine.199.en: You cannot delete your own account.
engine.199.zh: 不能删除你自己的账号。

engine.200.en: This is the only administrator left, so the account cannot be deleted.
engine.200.zh: 这是最后一位管理员，账号不能删除。

engine.201.en: That is not an action the console can take.
engine.201.zh: 这不是控制台能做的操作。

engine.202.en: Select at least one account first.
engine.202.zh: 请先至少选择一个账号。

engine.203.en: Type 1 to confirm deleting one account.
engine.203.zh: 输入1确认删除这一个账号。

engine.205.en: The harbor spent this leg's Parley on the Manifest Audit. {reopens} again next leg.
engine.205.zh: 港湾把本航段的洽谈用在了舱单稽查上。{reopens}要等到下个航段。

engine.206.en: This voyage's audit has already carried.
engine.206.zh: 本航程的稽查表决已经通过。

engine.207.en: Your name is already in for this leg's audit.
engine.207.zh: 本航段的稽查你已经投过票了。

engine.211.en: That offer is no longer available.

engine.212.en: You can't accept your own offer.
engine.212.zh: 不能接受你自己的报价。

engine.213.en: That offer is only open to a specific captain.
engine.213.zh: 那份报价只面向指定的某位船长。

engine.214.en: That captain is not here right now. Try again when they are back.
engine.214.zh: 那位船长现在不在。等他回来再试。

engine.215.en: Flexible bartering unlocks at Renown Level {FLEXIBLE_BARTER_UNLOCK_LEVEL}.

engine.216.en: Could not check Renown just now. Try again in a moment.
engine.216.zh: 刚才查不了声望。稍等片刻再试。

engine.217.en: That captain has not unlocked flexible bartering yet.
engine.217.zh: 那位船长还没有解锁灵活易货。

engine.218.en: Every flexible trade this voyage allows you has already been taken. You can still use the Captain's Exchange and accept any offer.
engine.218.zh: 本航程给你的灵活易货已经全部用完。船长行市照样能用，任何报价也照样能接。

engine.219.en: The harbor did not hear that leg move, so the ready check is open again. Press ready when you are done here and the voyage will carry on.
engine.219.zh: 港湾没有听到航段推进，就绪确认重新打开。这里忙完就点就绪，航程会继续。

engine.220.en: The tide has run out for this leg, and the harbor moves on. Any captain who had not finished commits the phase's own defaults.
engine.220.zh: 本航段的潮水已尽，港湾照常前行。还没收尾的船长，按本阶段的默认来。

engine.222.en: You are not in this draft.

engine.223.en: The table has moved past that step.

engine.224.en: Your card is already laid down.

engine.225.en: That is not one of the cards in front of you.
engine.225.zh: 那不是摆在你面前的牌。

engine.226.en: Too many actions at once. Give the harbor a moment, then try again.
engine.226.zh: 操作太频繁。让港湾缓一缓，再试一次。

engine.227.en: The harbor has already voted one of its own ashore this voyage.
engine.227.zh: 本航程港湾已经投票放逐过一位自己人了。

engine.228.en: The harbor has already written that captain off.
engine.228.zh: 港湾已经把那位船长划掉了。

engine.229.en: Your name is already in for this leg's maroon vote.
engine.229.zh: 本航段的放逐投票你已经投过了。

engine.230.en: A call in the closing leg would lean a market this voyage never opens.
engine.230.zh: 收尾航段里调价，拨动的会是本航程根本不会开的集市。

engine.231.en: A call leans a market up or down, and that frame named neither direction.
engine.231.zh: 调价要让集市升或降，那一帧却没说往哪边。

engine.232.en: A call has to name a port.
engine.232.zh: 调价，得说清是哪个港口。

engine.233.en: The Harbormaster's hand belongs to the captain the harbor put ashore.
engine.233.zh: 港务长之手属于被港湾放逐上岸的那位船长。

engine.234.en: The market this call lands on has not unlocked that port.
engine.234.zh: 这次调价落到的集市，还没有解锁那个港口。

engine.237.en: That request is no longer open.
engine.237.zh: 那份请求已经不再开放。

engine.238.en: You can't fund your own request.
engine.238.zh: 不能资助你自己的请求。

engine.240.en: That loan is no longer outstanding.

engine.241.en: That loan is not yours to repay.

engine.243.en: You can't back a loan you're already part of.
engine.243.zh: 你不能为你已经参与其中的借款作保。

engine.244.en: That loan already has a backer.
engine.244.zh: 那笔借款已经有人作保了。

engine.246.en: You can't direct an offer to yourself.
engine.246.zh: 不能把报价指定给自己。

engine.247.en: The Captain's Exchange is only open during the Parley phase.
engine.247.zh: 船长行市只在洽谈阶段开放。

engine.249.en: Every flexible trade that captain has this voyage is done.
engine.249.zh: 那位船长本航程的灵活易货已经全部用完。

engine.250.en: The bazaar is not running in this harbor.

engine.251.en: A rumor leans a price one way or the other, and no other way.
engine.251.zh: 风声只能把价格往一边拨，不能往别处。

engine.252.en: A rumor is spread at the Parley, where the whole table hears it.
engine.252.zh: 风声在洽谈时放出，全桌的人都听得见。

engine.253.en: The next port does not trade that good.
engine.253.zh: 下一个港口不做这种货的买卖。

engine.254.en: You already have an offer standing for anyone at this table.
engine.254.zh: 你已经挂着一份面向全桌任何人的报价了。

engine.255.en: The escort market is not running in this harbor.
engine.255.zh: 这个港湾没有开护航市场。

engine.256.en: One leg of protection is sold in the Parley phase.
engine.256.zh: 一个航段的护卫在洽谈阶段卖出。

engine.258.en: You can't sell protection to yourself.

engine.259.en: That offer is no longer on the board.
engine.259.zh: 那份报价已经不在板上了。

engine.260.en: That contract has already been agreed.

engine.261.en: That cover has already answered for a raid.
engine.261.zh: 那份护卫已经抵过一次劫掠了。

engine.262.en: That offer has already been turned down.
engine.262.zh: 那份报价已经被拒绝了。

engine.263.en: You are the one selling that protection.
engine.263.zh: 那份护卫是你自己在卖。

engine.264.en: A contract is agreed in the Parley phase.

engine.266.en: You have already turned that offer down.
engine.266.zh: 你已经拒过那份报价了。

engine.267.en: That contract is past the offer, so there is nothing to turn down.
engine.267.zh: 那份契约已经过了报价的阶段，没什么可拒的。

engine.268.en: That offer is open to the whole table, so there is nothing for one captain to turn down.
engine.268.zh: 那份报价面向全桌，轮不到某一位船长来拒。

engine.269.en: Only the captain who posted an offer can take it back.
engine.269.zh: 只有挂出报价的船长才能收回。

engine.270.en: That offer was turned down, so there is nothing to take back.
engine.270.zh: 那份报价已经被拒，没什么可收回的。

engine.271.en: That contract has been agreed, so it can't be withdrawn.
engine.271.zh: 那份契约已经议定，不能撤回。

engine.272.en: There is no agreed contract of yours to claim against.
engine.272.zh: 你没有已议定的契约可以索赔。

engine.273.zh: 那份契约保的是另一位船长。

engine.274.en: That contract was for an earlier leg.
engine.274.zh: 那份契约是更早航段的。

engine.275.en: The module market is not running in this harbor.
engine.275.zh: 这个港湾没有开模块市场。

engine.276.en: A listing names a module the yard can bolt on.
engine.276.zh: 挂单要写明船坞能装上的模块。

engine.277.en: A module is listed in the Parley phase.

engine.279.en: You can't sell a module to yourself.

engine.280.en: You have already listed that module this leg.
engine.280.zh: 本航段你已经挂过那个模块了。

engine.281.en: You are the one selling that module.
engine.281.zh: 那个模块是你自己在卖。

engine.282.en: A module trade is agreed in the Parley phase.
engine.282.zh: 模块交易在洽谈阶段议定。

engine.284.en: That module has been agreed, so the listing can't be withdrawn.
engine.284.zh: 那个模块已经议定，挂单不能撤回。

engine.285.en: The path draft is not running in this harbor.

engine.287.en: Your session expired. Sign in again to use Quick Start.
engine.287.zh: 你的会话已过期。重新登录后可使用快速开局。

engine.288.en: Could not find a harbor just now. Please try again.
engine.288.zh: 现在找不到可以进的港湾，请再试一次。

engine.289.en: The refit bench is not running in this harbor.
engine.289.zh: 这个港湾没有开整补台。

engine.290.en: A refit names a garment the crew can wear.
engine.290.zh: 整补要指定一件船员穿得上的衣物。

engine.291.en: A refit is agreed at a port, in the Market phase.
engine.291.zh: 整补在港口的开市阶段议定。

engine.292.en: You can't sell a refit to yourself.

engine.293.en: You have already taken on a refit this leg.
engine.293.zh: 本航段你已经接过一次整补了。

engine.294.en: You are the one selling that refit.
engine.294.zh: 那次整补是你自己在卖。

engine.295.en: That refit has been agreed, so it can't be withdrawn.
engine.295.zh: 那次整补已经议定，不能撤回。

engine.296.en: This voyage has already set sail.

engine.297.en: Only the host can start the voyage.

engine.298.en: Need at least one captain in the harbor to set sail.
engine.298.zh: 港湾里至少要有一位船长才能启航。

engine.299.en: Tidewatch Alert: the harbor takes notice of a bustling crew. One more cargo lot joins every captain's Port Purchase board, for the rest of this voyage.
engine.299.zh: 观潮预警：港湾瞧见船队忙起来了。本航程余下期间，每位船长的港口采购板上都会多出一件货物。

engine.301.en: Target must be between {CONVOY_VENTURE_MIN_TARGET} and {CONVOY_VENTURE_MAX_TARGET} Gold.
engine.301.zh: 目标金额得在{CONVOY_VENTURE_MIN_TARGET}金币到{CONVOY_VENTURE_MAX_TARGET}金币之间。

engine.302.en: Too late in the voyage to post a new Venture. There's no round left that would leave time to spend the reward.
engine.302.zh: 航程已经太晚，挂不出新的合股。剩下的轮数不够花掉那份报酬。

engine.304.en: That venture is no longer open.
engine.304.zh: 那份合股已经不再开放。

engine.305.en: That venture's deadline has already passed.
engine.305.zh: 那份合股已经过了截止时间。

engine.306.en: You've already backed this venture as much as any single captain can. It needs another captain to fund the rest.
engine.306.zh: 你对这份合股的出资已经到单人上限。余下的要等另一位船长出资。

engine.307.en: That venture is already fully funded.

room-a.014.en: A voyage leaves the pier when the host sets sail, not by readying up.
room-a.014.zh: 港主起航，船才离码头；光点就绪开不了船。

room-a.015.en: The Path Draft is left by laying your cards down. Each step turns over when every hand is in.
room-a.015.zh: 落牌，择道就结束。人人都出完牌，每一步才翻开。

room-a.016.en: Dawn is left by locking in a Boon. Pick one of the cards and it goes with you.
room-a.016.zh: 锁定一份机缘，破晓就结束。挑一张，它跟着你上路。

room-a.017.en: This voyage is over for you, so there is no seat left to leave.
room-a.017.zh: 这趟航程对你已经结束，没有席位可退。

room-a.018.en: Your own screen has work open on it. Finish or close it and the room moves on.
room-a.018.zh: 你自己屏幕上还有活没干完。做完或关掉，港湾才能往下走。

room-a.020.en: Highest Reputation in the harbor this voyage: {mine.reputation}.
room-a.020.zh: 本航程港湾里声誉最高：{mine.reputation}。

room-a.022.en: Renown Level {BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL} reached. The Broker owes you one, starting next voyage.
room-a.022.zh: 声望等级到{BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL}了。下一趟航程起，掮客欠你一份人情。

room-a.025.en: First to complete {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD} trade orders this voyage. +{data.reward} Gold.
room-a.025.zh: 本航程头一个交足{WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD}笔贸易订单。+{data.reward}金币。

room-a.027.en: You won the race to {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD} orders. +{data.reward} Gold.

room-a.030.en: The harbor takes notice of a bustling crew. One more cargo lot joins the Port Purchase board, every round, for the rest of this voyage.
room-a.030.zh: 船队一忙，港湾就留意到了。本航程余下每一轮，港口采购板上都多一件货。

room-a.032.zh: 港湾的声誉合计越过了{TIDEWATCH_SURGE_THRESHOLD}。

room-a.033.en: One extra cargo lot joins every Port Purchase board, every round.
room-a.033.zh: 每一轮，每块港口采购板上都多一件货。

room-a.035.en: Your voyage is recorded on the server.
room-a.035.zh: 你的航程已经记在服务器上了。

room-a.038.en: This seat is not left by pressing Next Phase
room-a.038.zh: 按下一阶段，退不出这个席位

room-a.043.en: A majority of the captains still sailing can open one manifest. What comes back is a sample of what they filed. A carried vote ends this leg's trading, and the voyage carries on at the next leg. The count below names who is still to vote, and what the vote does when the names it needs land on one captain.
room-a.043.zh: 仍在航的船长过半数，就能开一份舱单。开出来的是他们申报内容的抽样。表决过了，本航段的交易就到此为止，航程接着走下一航段。下面的计数写着还有谁没投，也写着所需的名字全落到同一位船长头上时，表决会起什么作用。

room-a.044.en: No order fulfillments filed this voyage.
room-a.044.zh: 本航程没有申报过一笔订单交付。

room-a.049.en: A captain the harbor has written off cannot be audited.
room-a.049.zh: 港湾已经划掉的船长，稽查不了。

room-a.050.en: an empty larder: this captain's crew is on short rations.
room-a.050.zh: 粮舱空空：这位船长的船员在吃减半口粮。

room-a.051.en: an empty larder, with no crew aboard to go hungry.
room-a.051.zh: 粮舱空空，船上没有船员会挨饿。

room-a.052.en: rations aboard, eaten one a head each leg.
room-a.052.zh: 船上有口粮，每航段每人吃一份。

room-a.053.en: {manifestLine} Opened by a majority in leg {reveal.round}, which closed that leg's trading; the finding stays on the table for the rest of the voyage.
room-a.053.zh: {manifestLine}第{reveal.round}航段过半数票开启，那一段的交易就此结束；这条结论在本航程余下期间留在桌上。

room-a.057.en: The Captain's Exchange at the Parley is open to you already.
room-a.057.zh: 洽谈里的船长行市，已经对你开了。

room-a.065.en: Direct this offer to a specific captain
room-a.065.zh: 把这份报价发给指定船长

room-a.066.en: Every flexible trade this voyage allows you has been taken. You can still use the Captain's Exchange and accept any offer.
room-a.066.zh: 本航程给你的灵活易货已经用光。船长行市还开着，报价你照样可以接。

room-a.074.en: No commodity on this route is traded yet, so there is nothing to say.
room-a.074.zh: 这条航路上还没有货物成交，没什么可说的。

room-a.075.en: Nobody has spoken at the bazaar yet this voyage.
room-a.075.zh: 本航程还没有人在香市开口。

room-a.076.en: Nobody has spoken in this leg or the one before it. The board keeps those two legs and no more. Older rows moved markets the room has already priced and traded through.
room-a.076.zh: 本航段和上一段都没人开口。板上只留这两段，再早的不留。更早的行拨动过的集市，全桌早就定价、交易过了。

room-a.077.en: Spoken in this leg. The next port prices this good against it, and the table reads which way you leaned the moment it does.
room-a.077.zh: 本航段已发声。下一港给这件货定价，就对着它来；价一落定，全桌都看得出你押的是哪一边。

room-a.078.en: Spoken in this leg. The direction belongs to the speaker until the next port prices it, so nobody at this table can tell a call from a lie yet.
room-a.078.zh: 本航段已发声。下一港定价之前，方向只有开口的人自己知道，所以全桌此刻分不清这句是真话还是谎话。

room-a.079.en: The market of this leg was priced against it, so the direction is public now.
room-a.079.zh: 本航段的集市就是对着它定的价，方向如今人人都看得见。

room-a.329.en: Your rumor is on the board and the harbor has your name and {good}. Only you know which way it leans: {direction}. The table reads it the moment the port of leg {landsOn} prices it. The bazaar is quiet for you until leg {nextLeg}.
room-a.329.zh: 你的风声已挂上板，港湾看到了你的名字和{good}。只有你知道它偏向哪边：{direction}。第{landsOn}航段的港口一给它定价，全桌就会读到。香市要到第{nextLeg}航段才重新听你。

room-a.330.en: The port of leg {landsOn} prices it. Speaking now quiets the bazaar for you until leg {quietUntil}.
room-a.330.zh: 第{landsOn}航段的港口会为它定价。现在开口，香市要到第{quietUntil}航段才重新听你。

room-a.083.en: Offer this contract to a specific captain
room-a.083.zh: 把这份契约发给指定船长

room-a.085.en: Nothing is on the market yet. Name a price and post the first offer, or wait and let a buyer come to you.
room-a.085.zh: 市场上还是空的。开个价，挂上头一份报价；不想开，就等着买家上门。

room-a.086.en: No protection is on offer this Parley. Only a Convoy captain at this table can sell one leg of cover, so their offer is what you are waiting for. An offer aimed at one captain waits on that captain, and an offer aimed at the table is any captain's to take.
room-a.086.zh: 本次洽谈没有护卫可买。一航段护卫只有本桌的镖行船长卖得出，你要等的就是他的报价。点名给某位船长的，就等那位船长；挂给全桌的，谁先接就是谁的。

room-a.098.zh: 护卫已用：你的炮口接下了劫掠

room-a.102.en: 🛡️ Your offer stands: {one.fee} Gold for one leg of cover, open to every captain here. The first to take it gets it.
room-a.102.zh: 🛡️ 你的报价还挂着：一航段护卫，{one.fee}金币，本桌每位船长都能接。谁先接，护卫归谁。

room-a.103.en: 🛡️ {standing.length} offers of yours stand this Parley, the newest at {standingFee} Gold. Each waits on the captain it names, or on the first captain to take an open one.
room-a.103.zh: 🛡️ 本次洽谈你有{standing.length}份报价挂着，最新的一份{standingFee}金币。点名给谁的，就等谁；挂给全桌的，谁先接算谁的。

room-a.105.en: You are selling one leg of cover for {fee}
room-a.105.zh: 你在卖一航段护卫，价格{fee}

room-a.106.en: You are covering {other} for {fee} this leg

room-a.107.en: Your guns answered a raid meant for {other}
room-a.107.zh: 本该落在{other}头上的劫掠，由你的炮口接下

room-a.304.en: ⏳ {sellerName} offers you one leg of cover for {fee} Gold. You are the one who answers: taking it pays the fee at the handshake, and turning it down leaves the row for them to read.
room-a.304.zh: ⏳ {sellerName}放出一段航段的护航给你，要价{fee}金币。答话的人是你：接下就在握手时付费，回绝了，这一行就留给他们自己看。

room-a.305.en: {sellerName} sells one leg of cover for {fee}

room-a.127.en: Standing orders are written and on
room-a.127.zh: 常备订单已写好并启用

room-a.128.en: Write what your seat should do when the clock plays it
room-a.128.zh: 写下席位在计时替你出牌时该怎么做

room-a.129.en: Restart the voyage for everyone in the harbor
room-a.129.zh: 为港湾内所有人重开航程

room-a.131.en: The ledger is empty. Set sail to begin recording your voyage.
room-a.131.zh: 账簿还是空的。一起航，你的航程就开始记了。

room-a.132.en: Every ledger update, harbor message, and direct message this session
room-a.132.zh: 本次会话中的每一笔账簿更新、港湾消息和私聊

room-a.133.zh: 本航程还没有记下什么。

room-a.135.en: Spend gold to reveal what Orders will ask for!
room-a.135.zh: 花点金币，看看订单会要什么！

room-a.136.en: The Broker only deals during Market.
room-a.136.zh: 掮客只在开市时做生意。

room-a.138.en: ✨ No rumors revealed yet... Spend gold to listen to the Broker's whispers.
room-a.138.zh: ✨ 还没听到任何密语... 花点金币，听听掮客密语。

room-a.140.en: Every captain currently in this harbor goes back to round one: gold, cargo, workers, and ship upgrades all reset. The harbor also reopens, so new captains can join again. This can't be undone.
room-a.140.zh: 港湾里现有的船长一律回到第一轮：金币、货物、工匠和船只升级全部清零。港湾重新开放，新船长还能再进来。这一步收不回来。

room-a.143.en: The harbor sails on without you: your seat is written off, and the gold and cargo you were carrying go with it. You can start or join a new harbor right away. This can't be undone.
room-a.143.zh: 港湾没有你照样开航：你的席位就此除名，你身上的金币和货也一并带走。你随时可以自己开一个港湾，或加入别的港湾。这一步收不回来。

room-a.158.en: Colorblind safe palette on, click to use the default colors
room-a.158.zh: 已开启色盲友好配色，点击恢复默认颜色

room-a.159.en: Use a colorblind safe palette for goods
room-a.159.zh: 为货物启用色盲友好配色

room-a.160.en: Harbor sounds on, click to mute
room-a.160.zh: 港湾音效已开启，点击静音

room-a.161.en: Turn on harbor sounds and UI feedback
room-a.161.zh: 开启港湾音效与界面提示音

room-a.338.en: Turn off the colorblind safe palette

room-a.168.en: A later call in this leg replaces this one.
room-a.168.zh: 本航段内后一次的押注会取代这一次。
