room-a.172.en: {MAROON_VOTE_SHARE} of the captains still sailing, rounded up, can put one captain ashore. The vote is public. Once a vote carries it is spent for the whole voyage, a vote that falls short can be called again on a later leg, and the captain who loses it keeps their seat at the table.
room-a.172.zh: 仍在航的船长里，{MAROON_VOTE_SHARE}（向上取整）赞成，就能把一位船长放逐上岸。表决是公开的。表决一过，本航程就把它用掉了；票数不够的，之后的航段还能再发起；输掉的那位照样保有席位。

room-a.176.en: {MAROON_VOTE_SHARE} of the captains still in the voyage carry it, rounded up, and the vote is public: every name behind a target is on this board.
room-a.176.zh: 仍在航程中的船长，{MAROON_VOTE_SHARE}（向上取整）赞成即通过；表决是公开的：谁把名字给了谁，这块板上都写着。

room-a.178.en: Called in leg {shift.round}. Every price at that port this leg was drawn against it.
room-a.178.zh: 第{shift.round}航段发起。本航段那个港的每个价格，都是对着它定的。

room-a.179.en: Called in leg {shift.round}. The market that opens next leg is the one that answers it, and a later call in this leg replaces it.
room-a.179.zh: 第{shift.round}航段发起。下一航段开市的集市就是它的回音；本航段里后押的一次会取代它。

room-a.316.zh: 你的定价从第{leg}航段起生效：

room-a.180.en: Every module on your hull is already on the board this leg. The market opens again next leg.
room-a.180.zh: 本航段你船体上的模块都已挂到板上。市场在下一航段重开。

room-a.184.en: Offer this module to a specific captain
room-a.184.zh: 把这个模块发给指定船长

room-a.185.en: Nothing on the market yet. List a module and yours is the first row. A listing comes off the board when the leg turns or the Parley closes, so a row you posted earlier may already be gone.
room-a.185.zh: 市场上还是空的。挂出一个模块，你的就是第一行。航段一换或洽谈一结束，挂单就从板上撤下，所以你早先挂出的那一行可能已经没了。

room-a.186.en: No modules on offer this Parley. Any captain with a module bolted on can list one, and a listing aimed at one captain waits on that captain.
room-a.186.zh: 本次洽谈没有模块在售。船体上装了模块的船长都能挂出一个；指名给谁的挂单，就等谁。

room-a.187.en: Every slot on your hull is full. Make room at the yard first.
room-a.187.zh: 船体上的槽位已经满了，先去船坞腾个地方。

room-a.193.en: The commission is met, and nothing more is owed.

room-a.194.en: The Emperor pays for what you hand over, and the commission is read when the voyage ends.
room-a.194.zh: 皇帝按你交上的货付钱，公议在航程结束时结算。

room-a.196.en: Every compass draw is public: the three cards each captain was shown, and the one they kept.
room-a.196.zh: 每次罗盘抽取都是公开的：每位船长看过哪三张牌，又留下了哪一张。

room-a.219.en: Not available right now, they may have stepped away.
room-a.219.zh: 现在看不了，对方可能走开了一会儿。

room-a.220.en: Cargo, artisans, equipped modules and the recent log.
room-a.220.zh: 货物、工匠、已装模块和最近记录。

room-a.337.en: Only {name} will see this offer, so nobody else can take it first. It still has to be taken {deadline}
room-a.337.zh: 这份报价只有{name}看得到，别人抢不走。接下它有个期限：{deadline}

room-a.228.en: This leg ends when the clock does, whether or not every captain has readied.
room-a.228.zh: 计时一停，本航段就结束，不管是不是每位船长都点了就绪。

room-a.230.en: You have already taken on a refit this leg, and one pair of hands works one garment. The bench opens again next leg.
room-a.230.zh: 本航段你已经接过一单整补，一双手只做一件衣物。整补台在下一航段重开。

room-a.234.en: have already worked on the crew this leg. Another garment waits for tomorrow.
room-a.234.zh: 本航段已经替船员缝补过了。另一件衣物，得等明天。

room-a.235.en: The garment this refit works on

room-a.238.en: Offer this refit to a specific captain
room-a.238.zh: 把这份整补发给指定船长

room-a.240.en: rag left for you this leg
room-a.240.zh: 本航段留给你的一块碎布

room-a.241.en: rags left for you this leg

room-a.242.en: No rags came ashore this leg. The pile only fills after a cold one.
room-a.242.zh: 本航段没有碎布上岸。布堆是走过一段寒程才添的。

room-a.243.en: The pile is what the fleet's scrap comes to after a cold leg, and it is drawn from the voyage's own weather. {REWEAVE_RAGS} rags go back on the loom as one {REWEAVE_GOOD}.
room-a.243.zh: 布堆是船队走完一段寒程后攒下的碎布，取的是本航程自己的天气。{REWEAVE_RAGS}块碎布回到织机，织成一件{REWEAVE_GOOD}。

room-a.244.en: have nothing to put right. Nobody in the crew is wearing anything.
room-a.244.zh: 没什么可修补的。船员身上一件衣物都没有。

room-a.245.en: have nothing to put right. The crew's clothes are whole.
room-a.245.zh: 没什么可修补的。船员身上的衣物都完好。

room-a.246.en: Nothing on the bench yet. Your offer is the first.
room-a.246.zh: 台上还是空的。你的报价就是头一份。

room-a.247.en: No refit work on offer this leg.
room-a.247.zh: 本航段没有在售的整补活计。

room-a.248.en: Nothing left to put right on your {row.good}.
room-a.248.zh: 你的{row.good}没什么可修补的了。

room-a.251.en: You are offering to put a {row.good} right for {fee}

room-a.300.en: {row.sellerName} offers to put a {row.good} right for {fee}

room-a.310.en: will put {points} back for {gold} Gold, once a leg.
room-a.310.zh: 会用{gold}金币把{points}补回来，每航段一次。

room-a.255.en: Every card in this harbor, face up
room-a.255.zh: 港湾里每一张牌，全部亮出

room-a.259.en: This seat took a berth after the hand was drawn, so the voyage wagered nothing on them and they won nothing from it.
room-a.259.zh: 这个席位是在牌发完之后才上船的，所以本航程没在他身上下过注，他也从中赢不到什么。

room-a.262.en: No leg of this commission was recorded, so there is no curve to draw.
room-a.262.zh: 这次公议没有留下任何航段记录，曲线也就画不出来。

room-a.263.en: What was traded on the record

room-a.264.en: No order fulfillment survived the voyage, which happens when a harbor buys and sells mostly through each other.
room-a.264.zh: 本航程一笔订单交付都没留下，港湾里若多是船长们彼此买卖，就会这样。

room-a.271.en: The fleet handed over what its captains reported each leg, and the Emperor read the board when the voyage ended.
room-a.271.zh: 船队每航段交出的，是船长们申报的数量；航程结束时，皇帝照着板上的数字来核。

room-a.272.en: The fleet handed over nothing it reported.
room-a.272.zh: 船队申报了，交出来的却是零。

room-a.273.en: Instructions your seat follows when the harbor's clock plays it while you are not standing at it.
room-a.273.zh: 你不在席位边上时，港湾的计时替你出牌，你的席位就照着这里写的走。

room-a.274.en: Three seats are deliberately not here. Parley is a conversation with a captain, which is not something a form can answer. The module draft is rolled fresh every round, so there is no honest way to name one ahead of it. And the Broker's Favor is a decision rather than a default, so it is left for you to spend.
room-a.274.zh: 这里故意空着三件事。洽谈是你和船长的一番对话，一张表格答不了。模块抽取每轮重新掷，事前写下名字并不诚实。掮客的人情是一次决定，不是默认，留给你自己花。

room-a.275.en: Kept with this voyage, and the table does not see it.
room-a.275.zh: 只随本航程保存，全桌看不到。

room-a.278.en: When the harbor's clock runs a phase out and you have not acted, your seat is played by what is written here instead of by the engine's own defaults. Turn this off and every seat goes back to being played the way it was before this panel existed. Nothing written below is lost either way.
room-a.278.zh: 港湾的计时把阶段走完，你还没出手，你的席位就照这里写的来，不照引擎自己的默认来。关掉它，所有席位就回到这个面板出现之前的执行方式。开关怎么拨，下面写的东西都不会丢。

room-a.279.en: Which boon to take when the draft is settled for you. A boon that is not on your board that round is passed over, so a name written here is never a promise the draft cannot keep.
room-a.279.zh: 抽取替你定下时取哪一份机缘。那一轮不在你板上的机缘直接跳过；写在这里的名字，绝不会是抽取兑现不了的承诺。

room-a.280.en: Each good you mark is bought from the purchase board whenever every good on that card is at or under the price you set, in the order the board is laid out. Anything dearer is left on the board.
room-a.280.zh: 你勾中的货，只要同一张牌上的货都不高于你设的价，就按板上的顺序买进。贵过头的留在板上。

room-a.281.en: The trade board, filled the way a captain would fill it: only what the hold can actually cover, in the order the orders are laid out, and left alone when the hold cannot cover it. Nothing is bought to complete an order, so one your hold cannot pay for in goods is skipped rather than chased.
room-a.281.zh: 订单板照船长自己的做法来交付：只动货舱真拿得出的货，按订单排的先后，货舱拿不出就不碰。不会为了交一份订单去买货；货舱拿不出货来付的那一份，跳过，不去追。

room-a.282.en: Fill every order the hold can cover
room-a.282.zh: 货舱拿得出的订单，每一份都交付

room-a.283.en: The shipyard's one standing choice: the next ship level, bought the moment the shipyard opens if the purse covers it. The purse and the hull's own ceiling are checked by the engine, so an order to upgrade that cannot be paid for simply does nothing.
room-a.283.zh: 船坞唯一的常备选择：升下一级船，船坞一开、钱袋够就买下。钱袋和船体自己的上限由引擎核对，付不起的升级指令就什么也不做。

room-a.284.en: Upgrade the hull when you can afford it

room-a.286.en: Whatever the draft laid down first, which is what an absent captain is given today.
room-a.286.zh: 抽取最先摆下的那一份，今天缺位的船长拿到的就是这个。

room-a.289.en: The room's count has not arrived yet. It comes with this leg's vote.
room-a.289.zh: 港湾的票数还没到，它随本航段的表决一起来。

room-a.292.en: Your name is not in yet. Pick a captain and press the button.
room-a.292.zh: 你的名字还没投。选一位船长，按下按钮。

room-a.293.en: Every captain still sailing has named someone, so nothing more can land this leg. A later leg can call this vote again.
room-a.293.zh: 仍在航的船长都投过了，本航段不会再有票落下来。之后的航段还能再发起这次表决。

room-a.296.en: The harbor has recorded nothing on this voyage yet.
room-a.296.zh: 本航程港湾还没有记下任何东西。

room-a.298.en: Nothing has been sent to you alone on this voyage.
room-a.298.zh: 本航程还没有单独发给你的东西。

room-b.008.en: Gold you lent before the wreck is still out there, and it lands the moment each captain repays it.
room-b.008.zh: 你翻船之前借出去的金币还在外面，哪位船长一还，它当场就到手。

room-b.011.zh: 观战模式：港湾实时排名

room-b.012.en: Your voyage has ended, but the rest of the harbor is still sailing. Watch their progress live below.
room-b.012.zh: 你的航程已经结束，港湾的其他人还在海上。在下面实时看他们的进展。

room-b.015.en: Click any captain in the Harbor Roster to peek at their cargo and workers
room-b.015.zh: 点港湾名册里的任意船长，就能瞧一眼他们的货物和工匠。

room-b.016.en: Funds depleted, unable to pay essential operational costs
room-b.016.zh: 资金见底，付不出必需的营运开销

room-b.017.en: Insufficient funds to cover maintenance and wages
room-b.017.zh: 资金不足，付不起维护费和工钱

room-b.308.en: Your voyage has ended, and the rest of the harbor has finished too.
room-b.308.zh: 你的航程已经结束，港湾的其他人也走完了。

room-b.309.en: Your voyage has ended, and the rest of the harbor has finished too. Wait for the host to restart the voyage, or set out for a new harbor now.
room-b.309.zh: 你的航程已经结束，港湾的其他人也走完了。等房主重开这趟航程；等不及，就现在启程去别的港湾。

room-b.018.zh: ⏱️ 生产周期：何时发生什么

room-b.035.en: The voyage begins once every captain has chosen.
room-b.035.zh: 每位船长都选好之后，航程就开始。

room-b.038.en: Draft a Boon to synergize with your strategy
room-b.038.zh: 抽取机缘，配合你的策略

room-b.044.en: Waiting for the host to restart the voyage…

room-b.055.en: ⏳ Waiting on the rest of the harbor to finish their voyage before Sea Master is crowned…
room-b.055.zh: ⏳ 港湾其余船长的航程还没走完，等他们结束后才加冕沧海之主...

room-b.056.en: Highest Reputation in this harbor's voyage.
room-b.056.zh: 本港湾航程中声誉最高的人。

room-b.063.en: Loan defaulted, no Renown banked this voyage.
room-b.063.zh: 借款违约，本航程没有入账声望。

room-b.076.en: Choose a module to install or swap.
room-b.076.zh: 选一个模块安装或切换。

room-b.077.en: No module choices are on offer right now. A fresh set is rolled each round.
room-b.077.zh: 现在没有可选的模块。每轮都会重新发一批。

room-b.078.en: Nothing new to deal: every module the yard could offer this hull is either on this table already or aboard. Take one of these, or come back next leg.
room-b.078.zh: 没有新牌可发：船坞能为这艘船开出的模块，不在桌上，就在船上。从这些里挑一个，或者下一航段再来。

room-b.090.en: No special interactions detected between equipped modules.
room-b.090.zh: 已装的模块之间，看不出有特别联动。

room-b.314.en: Freight Mastery: {bulkHauler} reduces transport per item and {silkMonopoly} can zero it out on any order carrying woven goods. Shipping costs almost nothing.
room-b.314.zh: 运费精通：{bulkHauler}压低每件运费，{silkMonopoly}能把带织物的订单运费清零。运费几乎不花钱。

room-b.099.en: Profit margin: {margin}% of reward is net profit after transport, VAT, and commission
room-b.099.zh: 利润率：报酬的{margin}%是扣掉运费、增值税和掮客抽成后的净利

room-b.323.zh: 💰 报酬：{reward}金币 📊 净利：{net}金币

room-b.106.en: (once per voyage): summon a guaranteed buyer for as much of a good as you choose from your hold. The bigger the ask, the bigger the Broker's cut.
room-b.106.zh: （每航程一次）：从你的货舱里挑一件货，要多少都行，替你把买主叫来。要得越多，掮客抽得越多。

room-b.109.en: Your hold is empty, so there is nothing for the Broker to sell right now.
room-b.109.zh: 你的货舱是空的，掮客现在没东西可出手。

room-b.110.en: Your hold changed while this was open, so there is nothing here for the Broker to sell now. Pick another good, or call the Favor in later this voyage.
room-b.110.zh: 这块面板还开着，你的货舱却变了，掮客现在没货可出手。换一件货，或者本航程晚些时候再动用这条人情。

room-b.112.en: A bigger ask pays out more, but the Broker's cut grows with it too, so a single favor can never swing the whole voyage.
room-b.112.zh: 要得越多进账越多，但掮客的抽成也跟着涨，所以一次人情翻不了整条航程的盘。

room-b.116.en: No offers on the board yet. Be the first.
room-b.116.zh: 板上还没有报价。做第一个。

room-b.125.en: No vote is open. The fleet's picks are on the record.
room-b.125.zh: 眼下没有开着的投票。船队的取舍都记在案上。

room-b.307.en: Only {name} will see this offer. A safeguard so nobody else can take it first.
room-b.307.zh: 这份报价只有{name}看得到，免得别人抢先接下。

room-b.128.en: The cards are being cut. If a hand was dealt to you, it lands here.
room-b.128.zh: 牌正在切。发到你手上的牌，会落在这里。

room-b.130.en: Three cards each, dealt face down. What you hold at the end is the path you sail this voyage, and the deal comes first because every stop after it reads your path: your hold, your Renown ceiling and the orders that lock to you.
room-b.130.zh: 每人三张，扣着发。最后留在你手里的，就是你本航程走的商道；发牌排在最前，因为之后每一站都要读你的商道：你的货舱、你的声望上限，还有锁给你的订单。

room-b.131.en: Your three cards. Keep one, and the other two pass to the left.
room-b.131.zh: 你的三张牌。留一张，另外两张传给左边。

room-b.133.en: Two cards arrived from your right. Keep one, and the other goes face down.
room-b.133.zh: 右边传过来两张。留一张，另一张扣下。

room-b.134.en: Your two papers. Keep the one you sail on, and the other goes over the side.
room-b.134.zh: 你的两份文书。留下你要走的这一份，另一份丢下海。

room-b.136.en: The table is in. The step closes now.
room-b.136.zh: 全桌都交齐了。这一步到此收尾。

room-b.143.en: Waiting for the rest of the crew

room-b.146.en: 🕵️ A corrupt broker leaked your position this round, so the odds above are already raised.
room-b.146.zh: 🕵️ 本轮有通匪掮客把你的位置透了出去，上面的概率已经跟着抬高。

room-b.151.en: Before this round's bills come due, your ship has to clear open water. Pirates that find you this round meet a shield you already paid for, so there is nothing here left to buy and nothing in your hold that is theirs.
room-b.151.zh: 在本轮账单到期之前，你的船得先过一段开阔水面。本轮找上你的海盗，撞上的是你早已付过钱的那面盾，所以这里没剩什么可买，海盗也拿不走你货舱里的东西。

room-b.156.en: ✅ Board Done, to the Artisan Bench

room-b.159.en: (a matching order is guaranteed at Orders, buy accordingly).
room-b.159.zh: （订单阶段保证有对得上的订单，可照此采购）。

room-b.160.en: What the board is worth: usual prices, the best of the six, and how deep each good runs.
room-b.160.zh: 这块板值多少：平日的价格、六张里最划算的那张，还有每件货的货源厚薄。

room-b.161.en: A Loom captain's work: a garment put right in one leg, at a fee the two of you agree.
room-b.161.zh: 织造船长的手艺：一个航段内把一件衣物整好，价格由你们两人商定。

room-b.174.en: Matches a Broker's Whisper, guaranteed order at Orders
room-b.174.zh: 与一条掮客密语对得上，订单阶段必有对应的订单

room-b.175.en: {good} is about {abovePct} percent above its usual price this round

room-b.176.en: {good} is about {belowPct} percent below its usual price this round

room-b.179.zh: ━━ 集市价格参考（悬停看详情） ━━

room-b.184.en: one ration a head, eaten at each Dawn
room-b.184.zh: 每人一份口粮，破晓时吃掉

room-b.185.en: No crew aboard, so there is nobody to feed. Hire artisans and the larder starts to matter.
room-b.185.zh: 船上没有船员，也就没人要喂。雇了工匠，粮舱才开始要紧。

room-b.186.en: The larder is full, so there is nothing more to buy here.
room-b.186.zh: 粮舱满了，这里没什么可再买的。

room-b.187.en: Not enough Gold for a leg of rations.
room-b.187.zh: 金币不够买一个航段的口粮。

room-b.192.en: The three foods the crew eats, and a batch of Produce ready to preserve.
room-b.192.zh: 船员吃的三样口粮，另有一批时鲜可以腌制。

room-b.193.en: The three foods the crew eats, and what each keeps.
room-b.193.zh: 船员吃的三样口粮，各能存多久。

room-b.194.en: The barge has nothing left for you this leg.
room-b.194.zh: 补给驳船这一航段没剩什么给你了。

room-b.195.en: The barge has nothing left for you this leg, and it is a fresh lot tomorrow.
room-b.195.zh: 补给驳船这一航段没剩什么给你了，明天会来一批新的。

room-b.344.en: {bargeLeft} ration{pluralS} {beWord} left for you this leg.

room-b.196.en: Short on Gold? Ask the Harbor for Help

room-b.346.en: No other captain is aboard, so there is no one to lend. The bills must be settled alone: Force Payment below covers what the purse holds, and the shortfall is the risk it names.
room-b.346.zh: 船上没有别的船长，没人能放款。账单只能独自结清：下面的强制付款会先掏空钱袋里有的，剩下的缺口，就是它点明的风险。

room-b.206.en: now, only spent if the loan actually defaults, up to what you pledged. Never called on? It all comes back, plus a small Reputation bonus.
room-b.206.zh: ，只有借款真的违约才会动用，最多到你作保的数目。要是一次都没动用？全数退回，还多一份小小的声誉加成。

room-b.207.en: Gold to pledge backing {l.lenderName}'s loan to {l.borrowerName}
room-b.207.zh: 为{l.lenderName}借给{l.borrowerName}的这笔借款作保的金币数

room-b.216.en: 🛡️ Escort hired, you sailed through safely this round.
room-b.216.zh: 🛡️ 雇了护航，本轮平安驶过。

room-b.217.en: 🌊 You sailed without an escort this round.
room-b.217.zh: 🌊 本轮没有雇护航就出海了。

room-b.351.en: Force Payment and Risk Bankruptcy ({money}/{totalDue} Gold)
room-b.351.zh: 强制付款，承担破产风险（{money}/{totalDue}金币）

room-b.353.en: ↳ 🪷 Jade Pavilion covers the wage for {items} this round
room-b.353.zh: ↳ 🪷 本轮{items}的工钱由玉阁代付

room-b.220.en: No modules installed. Upgrade ship to unlock slots!
room-b.220.zh: 还没装模块。升级船只就能解锁模块槽位！

room-b.223.en: ⏳ Waiting for the rest of the crew…

room-b.225.zh: 🔄 抽取并切换模块（槽位已满）

room-b.228.en: The sea is mild this leg and asks for no warmth. The clothes wait in the hold for a cold leg, because a garment wears from the day it goes on.
room-b.228.zh: 这一航段海上温和，用不着御寒。衣物留在货舱里等寒程，因为衣裳从穿上的那天起就开始磨损。

room-b.229.en: No crew aboard, so there is nobody to wear them. Hire artisans and the cold starts to matter.
room-b.229.zh: 船上没有船员，也就没人穿。雇了工匠，寒冷才开始要紧。

room-b.230.en: The hold carries no clothes. Linen Clothes, Cotton Clothes and Brocade are made right here at the bench, and the ones the crew wears are the ones it cannot sell.
room-b.230.zh: 货舱里没有衣物。麻衣、布衣和绫罗绸缎就在这里的匠作台上做出来，船员穿戴的那些，就是卖不出去的那些。

room-b.232.en: a garment worn stays on until it wears out
room-b.232.zh: 衣物上了身，就得一直穿到磨坏

room-b.234.en: ⚠️ The crew is short of warm clothes. The cold takes the newest hand, who is out of action for the next leg.
room-b.234.zh: ⚠️ 船员御寒衣物不够。寒冷会冻倒最新来的那个人手，下一航段上不了工。

room-b.235.en: The crew is dressed for the cold this leg. The rest stay in the hold until a leg asks for more.
room-b.235.zh: 这一航段船员穿够了御寒衣物。其余的留在货舱，等哪一航段要得更多再拿出来。

room-b.251.en: {skilled} of {count} trained: each produces 2 per round, working at {pacePct}% pace while the crew goes hungry
room-b.251.zh: {count}人中有{skilled}人熟练：每人每轮产出2件，船员挨饿时干活的速度只有{pacePct}%

room-b.253.en: Too late in this voyage to post a new Venture: there is no round left that would leave time to spend the reward.
room-b.253.zh: 本航程已太晚，发不了新的合股：剩下的轮数，不够把回报花出去。

room-b.257.en: Miss the deadline and every contributor only gets back a partial refund. This harbor only gets one venture per voyage, so make it count.
room-b.257.zh: 过了期限，每位出资人只能拿回一部分退款。每座港湾每航程只有一次合股，想清楚再用。

room-b.258.en: You have backed this as much as any single captain can. It needs another captain to fund the rest.
room-b.258.zh: 你已按单人上限跟投了这一笔。剩下的要另一位船长来凑。

room-b.261.en: No ventures open. This voyage's one chance has already been used.
room-b.261.zh: 眼下没有在筹的合股。本航程唯一的一次机会已经用掉。

room-b.262.en: No ventures open right now. Post one, or wait for another captain to.
room-b.262.zh: 眼下没有在筹的合股。你可以发一个，或者等别的船长发。

room-b.266.en: 🚨 Risk: Funds may fall short at round end!
room-b.266.zh: 🚨 风险：本轮结束时资金可能不够！

room-b.267.en: Nothing is owed until the voyage is under way.
room-b.267.zh: 航程开始之前，什么都不欠。

room-b.275.en: Your path is {card.name}. Change your papers.
room-b.275.zh: 你的商道是{card.name}。切换你的文书。

room-b.276.en: No path yet. The deal is open: keep one of the cards dealt to you.
room-b.276.zh: 还没有商道。牌局开着：从发给你的牌里留一张。

room-b.277.en: No path yet. A path is dealt when the voyage sails.
room-b.277.zh: 还没有商道。航程出海时会发商道。

room-b.278.en: No path yet. The deal ran before you came aboard, so you sail this voyage without one.
room-b.278.zh: 还没有商道。发牌在你上船之前就结束了，所以本航程你就这样出海，没有商道。

room-b.280.en: No modules installed. Upgrade the ship in the Shipyard to unlock slots.
room-b.280.zh: 还没装模块。到船坞升级船只就能解锁模块槽位。

lobby.003.en: Show the recommended action for this phase
lobby.003.zh: 看看本阶段推荐怎么做

lobby.008.en: Only one round remains. Hiring now wastes Gold on wages with no production return. Focus on filling orders with what you already have.
lobby.008.zh: 只剩最后一轮。这会儿雇工，工钱照付，产出却回不了本。手上的货，先拿去交付订单吧。

lobby.010.en: Your {type} is idle and you have the materials to make {product}. Assign the task now so production lands at this round's Resolve. Materials: {materialsList}.
lobby.010.zh: 你的{type}闲着，原材料也够，能做{product}。现在就安排上工，本轮结算时产出就到手。原材料：{materialsList}.

lobby.012.en: Your {type} is idle but you lack materials for {product}. You need: {materialsList}. Buy these next round.
lobby.012.zh: 你的{type}闲着，做{product}的原材料却不够。还缺：{materialsList}。下一轮再买这些。

lobby.014.en: Your hold carries no goods to trade this Parley. Post a Gold offer for the good you still need, or ready up so the fleet can move on.
lobby.014.zh: 这轮洽谈，你货舱里没有能出手的货。可以为你还缺的货挂一份金币报价，或者直接点就绪，让船队接着走。

lobby.015.en: You are holding {count} {top}. Post what your voyage can spare and name the good you are still short of, then ready up once the table is done with you.
lobby.015.zh: 你手上有{count}件{top}。这程能匀出多少就挂多少，写明你还缺哪件货，等桌上的人跟你谈完，再点就绪。

lobby.017.en: You are only missing {missingGood} (have {missingHave}, need {missingNeed}). Try bartering for it now; a fresh order board is dealt each round.
lobby.017.zh: 你只缺{missingGood}（现有{missingHave}，需要{missingNeed}）。现在就找船长易货；订单板每轮都会重新发一份。

lobby.019.en: Ship upgrade costs {cost} Gold but you only have {game.money}. Save the Gold for the Resolve bills and continue the voyage.
lobby.019.zh: 船只升级要{cost}金币，你手上只有{game.money}。金币留着结算付账，航程先接着走。

lobby.257.en: You have {gold} Gold. The {name} gives {amount} Gold immediately, which should cover wages and maintenance this round. Without it, you risk bankruptcy at Resolve.
lobby.257.zh: 你手头有{gold}金币。{name}立刻给{amount}金币，本轮工钱和维护费应该就有着落了。没有它，结算时就要冒破产的风险。

lobby.260.en: You have {score} Reputation. With high earnings expected, the {name} cuts income tax from {taxRatePct}% to {shelterRatePct}%, saving Gold at round end.
lobby.260.zh: 你有{score}声誉。预期收益高的话，{name}能把所得税从{taxRatePct}%降到{shelterRatePct}%，轮末省下一笔金币。

lobby.262.en: A Weaver needs {weaverWage} Gold per round in wages. With {gold} Gold, you can only cover {wageRounds} rounds. Wait until you have at least {hireBar} Gold before hiring.
lobby.262.zh: 织女每轮的工钱是{weaverWage}金币。你手里{gold}金币，只够付{wageRounds}轮。先别雇，等攒到{hireBar}金币再说。

lobby.022.en: The harbor leans this way for a fortnight
lobby.022.zh: 这半个月，港湾都偏向这边。

lobby.023.en: Every captain in every harbor shares the same Age at the same moment. The rotation cycles through the Lender, the Trader, and the Broker every two weeks, then repeats. An Age only shifts the weight of one already legal action, never the rules, which keeps a voyage that began under one Age from unbalancing when the next takes over.
lobby.023.zh: 每个港湾、每位船长，同一时刻，同一个时代。时代每两周换一轮：放贷人、商人、掮客，换完从头再来。时代只调一调某个本就允许的动作的分量，规则一个字不改；一段时代里开的航程，不会因为下一段时代接手就失了平衡。

lobby.025.zh: 当前时代：{age.name}。点击查看详情。

lobby.031.en: Maritime trade on the ancient Silk Road

lobby.032.en: Open this page in another browser to register a second captain and see them appear online in real time.
lobby.032.zh: 在另一个浏览器里打开这一页，再注册一位船长，就能实时看到对方上线。

lobby.053.en: Monsoon Season is very tough for a new captain. Consider Open Waters or Fair Winds until you reach Renown Level {OPEN_WATERS_RENOWN}.
lobby.053.zh: 季风时节，新船长很难熬。声望等级到{OPEN_WATERS_RENOWN}之前，先跑开阔水域或顺风。

lobby.054.en: Open Waters introduces mandates and charter goods. Try a few Fair Winds voyages first to learn the core loop.
lobby.054.zh: 开阔水域才有皇命采办和特许货物。先跑几程顺风，把基本玩法摸熟。

lobby.270.en: You have the experience and the streak for the {name}. {rounds} rounds, {multiplier}x Renown, and two difficulty scoped Merits await: Storm Sovereign and Eye of the Storm.
lobby.270.zh: 你有阅历，也有连续不破产的记录，{name}撑得起。{rounds}轮，{multiplier}倍声望，还有两项难度专属功勋等着你：风暴之主和风暴之眼。

lobby.057.en: Put ashore by a vote of the harbor

lobby.060.zh: 已加入世家的船长，全部计入。

lobby.065.zh: 所有航程中的顶尖船长

lobby.066.en: No captains have completed a voyage yet.
lobby.066.zh: 还没有船长完成过航程。

lobby.067.en: Set sail to be the first on the board.

lobby.076.en: Match instantly with the next captain who hits Quick Start.
lobby.076.zh: 下一位点快速开局的船长，立刻和你配对。

lobby.080.en: Every harbor the fleet has open right now.
lobby.080.zh: 船队此刻开放的所有港湾。

lobby.084.en: Name a harbor, pick its waters, and open it to the fleet.
lobby.084.zh: 给港湾起个名字，选好水域，向船队开放。

lobby.088.en: A captain's tenth completed voyage hands them this phrase, and the guide keeps a copy for whoever goes looking. Anyone who has it can open the table, and every seat at that table sails the voyage it opens.
lobby.088.zh: 船长完成第十次航程，就能拿到这句暗语；指南也为上门来查的人留了一份。暗语在手，谁都能开这张桌子；坐上桌的每个席位，都驶进它开的那次航程。

lobby.103.zh: 例如：丝路行程 · 航程 1

lobby.104.en: The phrase the harbor asks for

lobby.106.en: Renown level up! A bigger start of voyage Gold bonus awaits.
lobby.106.zh: 声望升级！下回开航，金币奖励更丰厚。

lobby.107.en: Fair winds. Come back tomorrow for the next reward.
lobby.107.zh: 顺风。明天再来领取下一份奖励。

lobby.109.en: Come back tomorrow for the next reward.
lobby.109.zh: 明天再来领取下一份奖励。

lobby.111.en: Could not reach the Harbormaster. Try again.
lobby.111.zh: 联系不上港务长，再试一次。

lobby.113.en: Still connecting to the harbor. Try again in a moment.
lobby.113.zh: 还在连接港湾。请稍后再试。

lobby.115.en: Pairing you with the next captain who asks.
lobby.115.zh: 正在把你和下一位点快速开局的船长配到一起。

lobby.116.en: Quick Start timed out. Please try again.
lobby.116.zh: 快速开局超时了，再试一次。

lobby.117.en: Quick Start matched a harbor, but it could not be reached.
lobby.117.zh: 快速开局配到了港湾，却连不上。

lobby.118.en: Quick Start is unavailable right now.

lobby.126.en: Your House perk applies on your next fresh voyage.
lobby.126.zh: 你的世家优待，从下个全新航程开始生效。

lobby.130.en: No captains in this harbor yet.
lobby.130.zh: 这个港湾里还没有船长。

lobby.131.en: You have already reported this captain this voyage.
lobby.131.zh: 本次航程你已经举报过这位船长。

lobby.132.en: Report filed. It goes on the record for this voyage.
lobby.132.zh: 举报已提交，会记进本航程的记录。

lobby.139.en: Ambient harbor bed and UI feedback tones
lobby.139.zh: 港湾环境音与界面提示音

lobby.146.en: Use Okabe Ito anchored colors for all goods
lobby.146.zh: 所有货物都使用 Okabe Ito 配色

lobby.148.en: Messages from the other captains in the harbor
lobby.148.zh: 港湾里其他船长发来的消息

lobby.149.zh: 抢先交满{WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD}笔订单的竞赛

lobby.153.en: The host has muted you in the harbor chat for the rest of this voyage.
lobby.153.zh: 本航程余下的时间，港主已经把你禁言，港湾聊天里说不了话。

lobby.160.en: Pick a captain to message privately
lobby.160.zh: 选一位船长，私下发消息

lobby.161.en: No other captains available right now. They will appear here once they are online.
lobby.161.zh: 眼下没有别的船长可选。等他们上线，就会出现在这里。

lobby.167.en: Hit Quick Start above to be paired with the next captain looking, or switch to Chart a new harbor and open a room of your own.
lobby.167.zh: 点上面的快速开局，和下一位找港湾的船长配对；或者切到开一个新港湾，自己开一间。

lobby.170.en: This voyage has already set sail

lobby.172.en: Pick a captain from the list above to start a private conversation.
lobby.172.zh: 从上面的名单里选一位船长，就能私下交谈。

lobby.179.en: Renown carries across every voyage this account ever sails, in any harbor.
lobby.179.zh: 这个账号驶过的每一次航程，不管在哪个港湾，声望都攒在一起。

lobby.180.en: Claim a Renown reward each day. The 7 day cycle picks up where you left off, even after a missed day, and restarts once Day 7 is claimed.
lobby.180.zh: 每天能领一份声望奖励。七天一轮，漏了一天也接着上次往下走，领过第七天就从头再来。

lobby.181.en: The Harbormaster's ledger of your finished voyages, newest first.
lobby.181.zh: 港务长替你记着跑完的航程，最新的排最前。

lobby.183.en: No chronicles yet. Finish a voyage and your headline will be inscribed here.
lobby.183.zh: 还没有航程实录。完成一次航程，你的标题就会刻在这里。

lobby.184.en: Pledge to one House. Its perk applies on your next fresh voyage. Switch any time between voyages.
lobby.184.zh: 加入一个世家。优待从你下个全新航程开始生效；两个航程之间，随时能换。

lobby.189.zh: 今日已签到 · 明天再来

lobby.239.zh: 领取第{day}天：+{xp} 声望经验

lobby.203.en: No chronicles saved yet. A chronicle is written when your voyage concludes.
lobby.203.zh: 还没有保存的航程实录。航程结束时，就会写下一份。

lobby.205.en: No merits earned yet. Complete voyages to earn them.
lobby.205.zh: 还没有拿到功勋。跑完航程就能挣到。

lobby.208.en: No rivals yet. Sail in the same harbor as another captain to build a rivalry.
lobby.208.zh: 还没有对手。和另一位船长在同一个港湾航行，就会结成对手。

lobby.211.zh: 连续不破产的航程次数

lobby.212.en: Share of voyages won as Sea Master
lobby.212.zh: 荣登沧海之主的航程占比

lobby.213.en: No voyage records yet. Set sail to begin your legacy.
lobby.213.zh: 还没有航程记录。起航，开始你的传承。

lobby.223.en: No snapshot yet. Tap the eye again.
lobby.223.zh: 还没有快照。再点一下那只眼睛。

lobby.229.en: You have reported this captain this voyage
lobby.229.zh: 本次航程你已经举报过这位船长

lobby.230.en: Only the host can mute a captain.
lobby.230.zh: 只有港主可以禁言船长。

lobby.232.en: That report could not be filed. Try again in a moment.
lobby.232.zh: 举报没能提交。请稍后再试。

misc.002.en: No account found with that captain name. Please check the spelling or register a new account.
misc.002.zh: 没有查到用这个船长名的账号。核对一下拼写，或者注册新账号。

misc.003.en: The password you entered is incorrect.

misc.004.en: That voyage save is too large to store.
misc.004.zh: 本航程的存档太大，存不下。

misc.007.en: A 6 character room code is required

misc.008.en: No room exists with that code
misc.008.zh: 这个口令对不上任何港湾

misc.009.en: That phrase opens a different voyage than the one asked for.
misc.009.zh: 这句暗语开的航程，不是你要开的那次航程。

misc.010.en: That phrase does not open this voyage. Check the words and try again.
misc.010.zh: 这句暗语开不了本航程。核对一下字句，再试一次。

misc.011.en: This voyage is sealed. It opens with a phrase, and the harbor was not given one.
misc.011.zh: 本航程是封着的，要用暗语才开得起来，可开辟时没填暗语。

misc.015.en: The host has muted you in the harbor chat for the rest of this voyage.
misc.015.zh: 本航程余下的时间，港主已经把你禁言，港湾聊天里说不了话。

misc.016.en: Nothing on the harbor square yet. Say hello to the fleet.
misc.016.zh: 港湾广场上还什么都没有。跟船队打个招呼吧。

misc.017.en: No messages yet. Break the ice with your fellow captains.
misc.017.zh: 还没有消息。先跟同席船长们搭一句话吧。

misc.018.en: No messages yet between you two.

misc.020.en: Gain {EMERGENCY_LOAN_GOLD} Gold immediately. No strings attached.
misc.020.zh: 立即获得{EMERGENCY_LOAN_GOLD}金币，无需偿还。

misc.024.en: The yards need rope. Hemp by the bale, and linen to back it.
misc.024.zh: 船坞要用绳索。麻布要成包的，还要麻布做衬。

misc.026.en: Two holds of the old trade, silk from the north and tea from the south.
misc.026.zh: 老买卖的两舱货，北边的丝绸，南边的茶叶。

misc.028.en: The garrison is being re-kitted, and the weaving houses cannot do it alone.
misc.028.zh: 守军要换装，织造人家顾不过来。

misc.030.en: Sachets for the court, tea for the road, and hemp to wrap the lot.
misc.030.zh: 朝廷的香囊，路上的茶叶，还有裹这批货的麻布。

misc.032.en: Brocade for the reception, and the raw stuff to keep the looms turning.
misc.032.zh: 待客的绫罗绸缎，还有让织机转不停的原材料。

misc.034.en: Nothing finished, nothing fancy. The founding three, and a great deal of them.
misc.034.zh: 不要成品，不要稀罕货。就是最初那三样，而且要多。

misc.036.en: You win if the fleet fills its commission and your own goal above is met with it.
misc.036.zh: 船队凑齐公议，你上方那条个人目标也跟着完成，这局就归你。

misc.037.en: You win if the fleet fills its commission.
misc.037.zh: 船队凑齐公议，这局就归你。

misc.038.en: You win if you take at least {BROKER_PAYOUT_TARGET} Gold from other captains in trade. The commission is their business rather than yours, so a voyage they finish well is no loss to you.
misc.038.zh: 只要在交易里从别的船长手上赚到至少{BROKER_PAYOUT_TARGET}金币，这局就归你。公议是他们的事，不是你的。他们航程走得再漂亮，你也不吃亏。

misc.039.en: You win if the fleet falls short of its commission, and you still end the voyage solvent and rated at least a Qualified Trader.
misc.039.zh: 船队没凑齐公议，你到航程结束还没破产，评级至少是合格商人，这局就归你。

misc.044.en: {facts.captain} offers one leg of protection for {facts.fee} Gold.

misc.045.en: {facts.taker} buys a leg of protection from {facts.captain} for {facts.fee} Gold.

misc.046.zh: 冲着{facts.taker}去的海盗，撞上了{facts.captain}的炮口。

misc.047.en: {facts.captain} offers to put a {facts.good} right for {facts.fee} Gold.

misc.048.en: {facts.taker} pays {facts.captain} {facts.fee} Gold to put the {facts.good} right.

misc.049.en: {facts.captain} publishes a rumor about {facts.good} at the bazaar.

misc.051.en: This voyage has already set sail. Ask the host to open a new room.
misc.051.zh: 本航程已经起航。请港主另开一个港湾。

misc.054.en: One harbor is sealed as well as hard. It opens with a phrase, and the phrase is the second ledger, entered when the room is charted.
misc.054.zh: 有一座港湾，路难走，门也锁着。开它得用一句暗语，暗语就是第二本账簿，开辟港湾时填上。

misc.055.en: The harbor keeps one door shut, and {UNLOCK_EARNED_AT} completed voyages is what opens it: the phrase is {unlock.phrase}, and the guide has the line for whoever asks.
misc.055.zh: 港湾留着一扇门不开，完成{UNLOCK_EARNED_AT}次航程才打得开：暗语是{unlock.phrase}，谁问起，指南里就写着这一句。

misc.056.en: One action {why}, so nothing here can vouch for whether it landed. The register has been read again.
misc.056.zh: 有一项操作{why}，到底落没落下，这里作不了证。名册已重新读过。

misc.057.en: {count} actions {why}, so nothing here can vouch for whether they landed. The register has been read again.
misc.057.zh: 有{count}项操作{why}，到底落没落下，这里作不了证。名册已重新读过。

misc.059.en: was cut off by a dropped connection

misc.065.en: Another venture in the harbor already claimed this voyage's one chance. Full refund: +{mine.amount} Gold.
misc.065.zh: 港湾里另一笔合股抢先占了本航程唯一的一次机会。全额退款：+{mine.amount}金币。

misc.069.zh: {roster}位船长里，已有{named}位指认了他人。

residual.003.en: Signed out of the operator console.

residual.005.en: That setup code is not correct.

residual.006.en: You have no artisans yet. {apprenticeName} cuts hiring costs by {hireDiscountPct}% this round, letting you get a Weaver for {weaverThen} Gold instead of {weaverNow}. Good for establishing production early.
residual.006.zh: 你还没有工匠。{apprenticeName}本轮把雇工费用降低{hireDiscountPct}%：织女只要{weaverThen}金币，原本要{weaverNow}金币。适合早点把生产立起来。

residual.007.en: The best deal costs {finalCost} Gold but you only have {game.money}. Save your Gold for the Resolve bills. You can still barter for goods you need.
residual.007.zh: 最划算的一单要{finalCost}金币，而你只有{game.money}。把金币留给结算的账单吧，缺的货还能靠易货换。

residual.008.en: A Weaver costs {weaverWage} Gold per round and can make Linen Clothes from Hemp. You have {game.money} Gold, enough for {wageRounds} rounds of wages. Production runs the same round you assign it, so hire now to get goods by Resolve.
residual.008.zh: 一名织女每轮要{weaverWage}金币，能把麻布织成麻衣。你有{game.money}金币，够付{wageRounds}轮工钱。指派当轮就开工，现在雇，结算时就有货。

residual.009.en: This order pays {bestOrder.reward} Gold with an estimated net profit of {bestProfit} Gold after transport and taxes. It is the most profitable order you can complete right now.
residual.009.zh: 这份订单报酬{bestOrder.reward}金币，扣掉运费和税后估计净赚{bestProfit}金币。这是你现在能完成的最赚的一单。

residual.010.en: You owe about {totalDue} Gold in wages and maintenance but only have {game.money} Gold. Ask the harbor for a loan before settling, or you will go bankrupt.
residual.010.zh: 工钱和维护费大约欠{totalDue}金币，而你只有{game.money}金币。结算前先向港湾借一笔，不然就要破产了。

residual.011.en: You have {game.money} Gold, enough to cover the estimated {totalDue} Gold in wages and maintenance. Settle your bills and move on to Dusk.
residual.011.zh: 你有{game.money}金币，够付大约{totalDue}金币的工钱和维护费。结清账单，进入暮色。

residual.012.en: Upgrading costs {cost} Gold and gives +1 module slot and +{SHIP_DISCOUNT_PER_LEVEL} Gold transport discount. With {roundsLeft} rounds left, the transport savings alone will pay for the upgrade.
residual.012.zh: 升级要{cost}金币，换来 +1个模块槽位和 +{SHIP_DISCOUNT_PER_LEVEL}金币运费折扣。还剩{roundsLeft}轮，单是省下的运费就够回本。

residual.013.en: You have {game.equippedModules.length} of {game.shipLevel} module slots filled. An empty slot is wasted potential. Draft a module now to gain a permanent bonus.
residual.013.zh: 你的{game.shipLevel}个模块槽位装了{game.equippedModules.length}个。空着的槽位就是白扔的潜力。现在就去抽一个模块，换一份永久加成。

residual.014.en: You have {game.money} Gold. Spending {intelCost} Gold on a rumor guarantees a matching order in Orders, then buying the {bestGoodName} at {bestPrice} Gold per unit sets up a profitable trade.
residual.014.zh: 你手上有{game.money}金币。花{intelCost}金币买一条掮客密语，订单阶段就保有一条对得上的订单；再按每件{bestPrice}金币买进{bestGoodName}，一笔好买卖就成了。

residual.015.en: Best deal this round: {bestGoodName} at {bestPrice} Gold per unit from {bestCard.port}. This is {pricePct}% of the typical price range, making it a good value.
residual.015.zh: 本轮最划算：来自{bestCard.port}的{bestGoodName}，每件{bestPrice}金币，约为常见价格的{pricePct}%，值得入手。

residual.034.zh: 选中当前显示的全部账户

residual.041.en: Not available on your own account

residual.043.en: Banning ends every session the account holds and clears its seats on the spot. Deleting removes the account and every harbor it hosts, and cannot be undone.
residual.043.zh: 封停会当场结束该账户的所有会话，席位一并清空。删除则连账户带它主持的每一个港湾一起移走，撤不回来。

residual.045.en: The account is removed, along with every harbor it hosts, every seat it holds, and every voyage, chronicle and merit it has earned. Any captain sitting in one of those harbors is sent back to the Lobby. This cannot be undone.
residual.045.zh: 账户就此移走，连同它主持的每一个港湾、占着的每一个席位，以及一路赢下的航程、实录与功勋。还坐在这些港湾里的船长，全部送回大厅。撤不回来。

residual.048.en: Every account ticked is removed, along with every harbor it hosts, every seat it holds, and every voyage, chronicle and merit it has earned. Any captain sitting in one of those harbors is sent back to the Lobby. This cannot be undone.
residual.048.zh: 勾中的账户一并移走，连同它主持的每一个港湾、占着的每一个席位，以及一路赢下的航程、实录与功勋。还坐在这些港湾里的船长，全部送回大厅。撤不回来。

residual.060.en: There are no accounts to show.

residual.061.zh: 当前视图下没有匹配的账户。

residual.069.en: Registration needs the setup code the server was configured with. Accounts created here are administrators.
residual.069.zh: 注册要填服务器配置里的设置口令。在这里开的账户，都是管理员。

residual.074.en: The reading could not be loaded.

residual.075.en: The window could not be read.

residual.093.en: No Ocean Gambit voyage in the window yet: the panels below are the gates, and what each one waits on.
residual.093.zh: 窗口里还没有暗潮航程：下面的面板列出各道门槛，以及每道门槛在等什么。

residual.095.en: Nothing in this window was recorded: the sampler was off.
residual.095.zh: 这个窗口什么都没记到：采样器当时没开。

residual.481.en: Recorded at a sample rate of {samplePercent}%.

residual.103.en: 🔒 Broker's Favor unlocks at Renown {BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL}, {unlockTitle} ({favorLevelsToGo} level{pluralS} to go)
residual.103.zh: 🔒 掮客的人情在声望{BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL}解锁，即{unlockTitle}（还差{favorLevelsToGo}级）

residual.107.en: Head to head with {rival.displayName}: {rival.myWins} wins, {rival.theirWins} losses, {rival.ties} ties

residual.108.en: Your Renown and voyage count suggest you are ready for {openWaters.name}. {voyageRounds} rounds, {openWaters.renownXpMultiplier}x Renown, and Imperial Mandates on rounds {mandateRounds}.
residual.108.zh: 你的声望和航程数说明你可以试试{openWaters.name}了。{voyageRounds}轮，{openWaters.renownXpMultiplier}倍声望，第{mandateRounds}轮起有皇命。

residual.109.en: {fairWinds.name} is the right starting point. {voyageRounds} rounds, gentle pirate odds, and no mandates. Learn the loop before taking on heavier waters.
residual.109.zh: {fairWinds.name}是最合适的起点。{voyageRounds}轮，海盗概率温和，也没有皇命。先把循环摸熟，再去挑更重的水域。

residual.110.en: {monsoon.name} has a {raidOdds} pirate raid chance. Make sure you can survive a bankruptcy before risking it.
residual.110.zh: {monsoon.name}的劫掠概率是{raidOdds}。冒这个险之前，先确保自己扛得住一次破产。

residual.111.en: {data.winnerName} was first to complete {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD} trade orders this voyage.
residual.111.zh: {data.winnerName}在本航程率先完成了{WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD}笔订单。

residual.113.en: Hire artisans only when you can sustain at least two rounds of wages. {play.failureRule}
residual.113.zh: 至少付得起两轮工钱，才雇工匠。{play.failureRule}

residual.115.en: Press ? or F2 in a game room to see all keyboard shortcuts.
residual.115.zh: 在港湾里按 ? 或 F2，查看全部快捷键。

residual.117.en: {namesNeeded} on one captain opens that captain's manifest to the whole harbor and closes this leg's trading.
residual.117.zh: 一位船长身上凑够{namesNeeded}个名字，就能把那位船长的舱单向全港湾公开，并结束本航段的交易。

residual.118.en: This vote opens at leg {opensAt}, and this is leg {game.currentRound}. A simple majority of the captains still sailing then opens one captain's manifest: {AUDIT_REVEAL_WORDS} of their most recent order fulfillments, and nothing else. A carried vote ends that leg's trading, the voyage carries on at the next leg, and the harbor opens one manifest a voyage.
residual.118.zh: 这次稽查从第{opensAt}航段起开放，现在是第{game.currentRound}航段。还在航程里的船长，简单多数联署，就能公开一位船长的舱单：只公开他最近{AUDIT_REVEAL_WORDS}项订单交付记录，别的都不公开。联署通过的稽查会结束那一航段的交易，航程照常进入下一航段；每航程，港湾只公开一份舱单。

residual.119.en: Others can still take {draft.offersLeft} more offer{pluralS} from you this voyage.
residual.119.zh: 本航程别人还能从你这里接下{draft.offersLeft}份报价。

residual.120.en: Unlocks at Renown Level {FLEXIBLE_BARTER_UNLOCK_LEVEL}, {toGo} level{pluralS} to go.

residual.121.en: spoken in leg {row.round} · priced at leg {landsOn}
residual.121.zh: 第{row.round}航段开的口 · 第{landsOn}航段生效

residual.122.en: Speaking at the bazaar belongs to the {SELLER_PATH.name} path, and you do not hold it this voyage. Whoever holds it is named in the voyage log, and the board below names them the moment they speak.
residual.122.zh: 在香市开口，是{SELLER_PATH.name}之道的事，你本航程不持此道。持有它的人会写进航程日志；只要一开口，下面那块板子就写出名字。

residual.123.en: Once every {RUMOR_COOLDOWN_ROUNDS} legs, each {SELLER_PATH.name} captain may spread a word about one commodity, here at the Parley. The next port prices that good against it, by up to {rumorPct} percent, which is the same hand the Harbormaster leans a port with. The whole harbor is told who spoke and which good they named, and only the speaker knows which way they leaned until the port they named has priced it.
residual.123.zh: 每{RUMOR_COOLDOWN_ROUNDS}个航段一次，每位{SELLER_PATH.name}船长可以在洽谈时放出一件货的风声。下一港为那件货定价时会带上这个方向，最高{rumorPct}%，与港务长压港用的是同一只手。谁开的口、点的是哪件货，全港湾都会知道；只有开口的人自己知道押的是哪一边，直到他点名的那个港口为此定价。

residual.124.en: ✅ Your cover was spent this leg: {spent.sellerName}'s guns answered the raid and your Gold stayed where it was.
residual.124.zh: ✅ 本航段你的护卫派上了用场：{spent.sellerName}的炮口挡下了劫掠，你的金币分文未动。

residual.125.en: ✅ You are covered this leg by {covered.sellerName} for {covered.fee} Gold, paid at the handshake. A raid on your hold meets their cannons, and what their guns do not beat off comes out of their Gold.
residual.125.zh: ✅ 本航段{covered.sellerName}为你护卫，费用{covered.fee}金币，握手成交时付清。货舱若遇劫掠，由他们的炮口迎击，炮口挡不下的部分从他们的金币里出。

residual.127.en: {contract.sellerName}'s guns answered a raid meant for {who}

residual.129.en: 🛡️ You are covering {buyerName} this leg for {carrying.fee} Gold, already paid to you. Your Gold answers the raid their hold does not.
residual.129.zh: 🛡️ 本航段你替{buyerName}护卫，{carrying.fee}金币已先行付到你手上。轮到海盗找上门，应答的是这笔金币，不是他们的货舱。

residual.130.en: 🛡️ Your offer stands: {one.fee} Gold for one leg of cover for {buyerName}. It waits on them.
residual.130.zh: 🛡️ 你的报价还挂着：{one.fee}金币，为{buyerName}护一航段。就等他点头。

residual.131.en: 🚫 {buyerName} turned down your offer of {refused.fee} Gold. Nothing is owed either way, and the row stays until the leg turns.
residual.131.zh: 🚫 {buyerName}回绝了你{refused.fee}金币的报价。两不相欠，这一行会留到本航段结束。

residual.132.en: One leg of protection, sold by a Convoy captain at a price the two of them agree. The buyer pays the fee at the handshake, and it is the seller's cannons that answer the raid: {beatenOff} of it is beaten off, and the remaining {eaten} is deducted from the seller's Gold. The cover lasts the leg it was sold for and no other, and a raid that never comes costs the seller nothing. {ESCORT_OFFER_DEATH}
residual.132.zh: 一段护卫，由镖行船长出售，价格两人自己谈。买家在握手时付清费用；海盗来时，应答的是卖家的炮火：挡下{beatenOff}，余下的{eaten}从卖家的金币里扣。护卫只管它卖出的那个航段，多一段都不管；海盗没来，卖家分文不损。{ESCORT_OFFER_DEATH}

residual.133.en: You are the seller here, so the price is yours to name: the buyer pays it at the handshake, and your own Gold answers whatever your guns do not beat off, which is {eaten} of a raid, down to the bottom of your hold. {sellerRule} An open offer is any captain's to take, while a named one waits on the captain you named, and one open offer plus one per captain named is the most this market holds from you.
residual.133.zh: 在这里你是卖家，价格由你开：买家在握手时付清；你的炮火没挡下的部分由你的金币顶上，也就是一次劫掠里的{eaten}，一直扣到货舱见底。{sellerRule}公开报价人人可接，点名报价只等你点的那位船长；一份公开报价，加上每位被点名船长各一份，就是这个市场替你挂着的最多数量。

residual.134.en: ⏳ {readyLine} The phase turns when the rest do.
residual.134.zh: ⏳ {readyLine}其余人就绪后，阶段自会翻页。

residual.135.en: {namesNeeded} on one captain puts that captain ashore and spends the vote for the voyage.
residual.135.zh: 一位船长身上凑够{namesNeeded}个名字，就能把那位船长放逐上岸，并用掉本航程的这一次投票。

residual.136.en: This vote opens at leg {rung}, and this is leg {game.currentRound}. {MAROON_VOTE_SHARE} of the captains still sailing, rounded up, then put one captain ashore: the ship and its hold go to the harbor, half their Gold stays aboard, and the Harbormaster's hand is theirs for the rest of the voyage. One vote can carry a voyage, and a vote that falls short can be called again on a later leg.
residual.136.zh: 这次投票从第{rung}航段起开放，现在是第{game.currentRound}航段。还在航程里的船长，凑够{MAROON_VOTE_SHARE}（向上取整）联署，就能把一位船长放逐上岸：船和船上的货舱归港湾，一半的金币留在船上，港务长之手归联署的一方，直到航程结束。一票能左右整程；票数不够，之后的航段还能再发起。

residual.137.en: Voted ashore by {voteShare} of the harbor. The ship and everything on it went to the harbor, half their Gold stayed aboard, and the Harbormaster's hand is theirs for the rest of the voyage.
residual.137.zh: 被港湾{voteShare}的票数放逐上岸。船和船上的一切归了港湾，一半的金币留在船上，港务长之手归联署的一方，直到航程结束。

residual.138.en: The harbor has already named {maroon.carried.name} this voyage. The vote is spent: nothing more is asked of this table until a new voyage.
residual.138.zh: 本航程港湾已经把{maroon.carried.name}放逐了。这次投票已经用掉：新航程开始之前，不会再向这张牌桌要什么。

residual.139.en: The harbor put you ashore and left you its own lever: once a leg, name a port and lean every price at it by {shiftPct} percent, up or down. The call is public, and the market that opens next leg is the one that answers it.
residual.139.zh: 港湾把你放上了岸，也留给你一根自己的杠杆：每航段一次，点名一个港口，把这个港的价格整体抬高或压低{shiftPct}%。这次出手是公开的，下一航段开市的集市，就是回应它的那一个。

residual.140.en: Taking it would put your hull at {newPower} power, and a hull carries at most {HELD_POWER_CAP}.
residual.140.zh: 收下它会让船体达到{newPower}点力量，而船体最多承载{HELD_POWER_CAP}点。

residual.141.en: A module bolted to a hull, sold at a price the two of you agree. It comes off the seller's hull and onto the buyer's the moment the two of you shake hands, so the buyer needs an open slot, and a hull's ladder tops out at {MAX_SHIP_LEVEL} slots at ship level {MAX_SHIP_LEVEL}. The fee is paid when you shake hands. One listing per module a leg, one open offer per captain you name, and an offer nobody takes before the Parley closes is gone.
residual.141.zh: 装在船体上的模块，价格两人自己谈。一握手，它就从卖家的船体转到买家手上，所以买家得留一个空槽位；而船体的槽位上限，就是船只等级{MAX_SHIP_LEVEL}的{MAX_SHIP_LEVEL}个槽位。费用在握手时付清。每航段每件模块挂一次，每位被你点名的船长各接一份点名报价，洽谈关门前没人接的报价就此作废。

residual.143.en: {peerTradeProfit} of {BROKER_PAYOUT_TARGET} Gold. Only trades with other captains count, and only the coin that moved in them.
residual.143.zh: 已达{peerTradeProfit}/{BROKER_PAYOUT_TARGET}金币。只计入与其他船长的交易，而且只算其中真正易手的金币。

residual.144.en: Clothes lose a point of wear every leg and two on a cold one. A {SELLER_PATH.name} captain can put {REFIT_POINTS} points back in a single leg for whatever fee the two of you agree, and anyone can take {TAILOR_WORK} from the harbor tailors for {MEND_GOLD_PER_POINT} Gold. One open offer per captain you name, one refit taken on a leg, and an offer nobody takes before the Market closes is gone.
residual.144.zh: 衣物每个航段掉一点耐久，寒程掉两点。{SELLER_PATH.name}船长可以在一个航段里补回{REFIT_POINTS}点，价格两人自己谈；任何人都可以找港湾的裁缝做{TAILOR_WORK}，每点{MEND_GOLD_PER_POINT}金币。每位被你点名的船长各接一份点名报价，一个航段只能整补一次；开市关门前没人接的报价就此作废。

residual.147.en: No name is in yet. {namesNeeded} on one captain {carryWord} it.
residual.147.zh: 还没有人署名：一位船长身上凑够{namesNeeded}才能通过。

residual.149.en: Your name is in for {votedName}. Nothing else is asked of you this leg.
residual.149.zh: 你已把你的名字署给了{votedName}。本航段不再要求你做什么。

residual.150.en: {leader.name} has every name the vote needs.
residual.150.zh: {leader.name}已经凑齐了票上要的所有署名。

residual.153.en: {entries.length} {harborLines} in the harbor, {privateLog.length} {privateLines} to you alone

residual.154.en: 💡 Materials consumed now. Finished goods and wage deductions happen at {duePhase}, not instantly.
residual.154.zh: 💡 原材料现在就消耗。成品产出和工钱扣除发生在{duePhase}，不是立刻。

residual.156.en: Renown Level {BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL} reached. Starting next voyage, call one in from the Trade Manifest to summon a guaranteed buyer.
residual.156.zh: 声望等级{BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL}达成。从下趟航程起，可以在贸易舱单上动用一次人情，召来一位必定接手的买家。

residual.160.en: Replacing it would put your hull at {newPower} power, and a hull carries at most {HELD_POWER_CAP}.
residual.160.zh: 换上去会让船体达到{newPower}点力量，而船体最多承载{HELD_POWER_CAP}。

residual.161.en: Double Tax Strategy: {smugglersHoldName} reduces purchase costs and {taxEvasionName} halves both VAT and income tax. A powerful financial combo.
residual.161.zh: 双税战术：{smugglersHoldName}压低采购成本，{taxEvasionName}把增值税和所得税一起减半。一套强力的财务组合。

residual.162.en: Production Engine: {artisansWorkshopName} boosts worker output and {salvageCraneName} refunds the freight on some orders. More goods, more Gold back.
residual.162.zh: 生产引擎：{artisansWorkshopName}提升工匠产出，{salvageCraneName}退还部分订单的运费。货更多，金币回得更多。

residual.163.en: Intel Network: {brokersNetworkName} discounts every whisper, and {oceanRelayName} adds one more at no cost. Maximum market intelligence.
residual.163.zh: 密语网：{brokersNetworkName}让每条掮客密语都打折，{oceanRelayName}再免费加一条。集市密语拉满。

residual.164.en: Penalty Stack: {overdriveEngineName} adds maintenance and {bulkHaulerName} raises upgrade cost. Consider swapping one if funds are tight.
residual.164.zh: 负担叠加：{overdriveEngineName}增加维护费，{bulkHaulerName}抬高升级成本。手头紧就考虑换掉一个。

residual.165.en: Charter Combo: {kilnCellarName} discounts every bulk good, and {bureauTokenName} pays more on orders for the charter's own goods. Buy cheap, sell high.
residual.165.zh: 特许组合：{kilnCellarName}让所有散货都降价，{bureauTokenName}为特许自家货物的订单多付钱。低价买进，高价卖出。

residual.166.en: Exotic Trade: {foreignQuarterName} discounts every luxury good, and {fleetOfTreasuresName} takes Gold off freight on the same trade. Tier 2 goods at tier 0 prices.
residual.166.zh: 异域贸易：{foreignQuarterName}让所有奢华货物都降价，{fleetOfTreasuresName}在这类买卖上再削运费。二级货，零级价。

residual.167.en: 🧾 Est. VAT: {totalVat} Gold (per unit shown on hover)
residual.167.zh: 🧾 预估增值税：{totalVat}金币（单件明细悬停可见）

residual.168.en: 🔒 Broker's Favor unlocks at Renown Level {BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL}: call one in once per voyage to summon a guaranteed buyer for a good already in your hold. You are Renown Level {game.renownLevel} now, {levelsToGo} to go.
residual.168.zh: 🔒 掮客的人情在声望等级{BROKERS_FAVOR_UNLOCK_LEVEL}解锁：每航程可唤一次，为货舱里已有的一件货，招来一位必定接手的买家。你现在的声望等级是{game.renownLevel}，还差{levelsToGo}级。

residual.170.en: How much {favorItem} should the Broker sell?

residual.173.en: Before this round's bills come due, your ship has to clear open water. There is a {raidPct}% chance pirates find you and take every coin in your hold. Hire an escort to sail through safely, or risk it and save the Gold.
residual.173.zh: 本轮账单到期之前，你的船得先闯过一片开阔水域。海盗有{raidPct}%的概率找上你，把你舱里的每一枚金币都拿走。雇一艘护航安然驶过，要么就冒这个险，把金币省下。

residual.174.en: 🛡️ {cover.sellerName} sold you this leg's cover. Their cannons beat off {coverPct}% of a boarding party, and their own hold answers for the rest.
residual.174.zh: 🛡️ {cover.sellerName}把本航段的护卫卖给了你。他们的炮口能挡下登船队{coverPct}%的攻势，挡不下的部分由他们自己的货舱担着。

residual.175.en: Escort costs {escortFee} Gold but expected loss is {expectedLoss} Gold. Hiring the escort saves Gold on average.
residual.175.zh: 雇护航要{escortFee}金币，预期损失却有{expectedLoss}金币。平均算下来，雇护航反而更省。

residual.176.en: An unnamed trader on the quay: {bargePrice} Gold a ration against the port's {RATION_PRICE}.
residual.176.zh: 码头上的无名商贩：一份口粮{bargePrice}金币，港口的价是{RATION_PRICE}。

residual.177.en: a leg of rations costs {legCost} Gold

residual.179.en: Unpaid loans settle automatically at the end of Round {maxRounds}, and the Gold goes to the lender.
residual.179.zh: 未还清的借款会在第{maxRounds}轮结束时自动结清，金币归债主。

residual.180.en: A loan transfers instantly if someone helps. Repay it any time before the voyage ends. {loanDue}
residual.180.zh: 一有人出手，借款立刻到账。航程结束前随时可以还。{loanDue}

residual.181.en: 🆘 Waiting for a captain to lend you {myRequest.amount} Gold…

residual.182.en: Every module the yard could deal would pass this hull's {HELD_POWER_CAP} power. Selling one at the Parley table makes room.
residual.182.zh: 船坞能给到的模块，每一件都超过这条船体{HELD_POWER_CAP}点的承载上限。到洽谈桌卖掉一件，就腾出了位置。

residual.183.zh: 🚢 船只等级：{game.shipLevel}｜⚓ 折扣：{shipDiscount}金币

residual.184.en: ⚓ Upgrade Ship (Lvl {nextShipLevel}), Cost {upgCost} Gold | +1 Slot, +{SHIP_DISCOUNT_PER_LEVEL} Discount
residual.184.zh: ⚓ 升级船只（{nextShipLevel}级），花费{upgCost}金币｜+1槽位，+{SHIP_DISCOUNT_PER_LEVEL}折扣

residual.186.en: A garment the sea has worn out becomes rags and is scrapped for {RAG_SCRAP_VALUE} Gold. Frostbite costs the newest hand one leg of work rather than their place aboard.
residual.186.zh: 衣物被海磨破就成了碎布，拆掉换回{RAG_SCRAP_VALUE}金币。冻伤只让新来的人手歇一个航段的工，不会让他离开船。

residual.187.en: {raidPct}% chance of losing all Gold on hand
residual.187.zh: 有{raidPct}%的概率丢掉手头所有的金币

residual.188.en: ⏳ Waiting for the host to start the voyage… ({harborIds.length} in harbor)
residual.188.zh: ⏳ 等待港主启航...（港湾里{harborIds.length}人）

residual.441.en: 🌊 {rounds} rounds await, become the Sea Master!
residual.441.zh: 🌊 {rounds}轮航程在等你，去成为沧海之主！

residual.442.en: Your first seat is the {label}: three cards dealt face down, and the one you keep is the path you sail.
residual.442.zh: 你的第一个座位是{label}：三张牌扣着发下，留下哪张，就走哪条道。

residual.189.en: 💰 Current Funds: {game.money} Gold | 📦 See Inventory on the left
residual.189.zh: 💰 现有资金：{game.money}金币｜📦 存货见左侧

residual.191.en: Once a voyage, at a port in legs {PATH_SWITCH_FROM_ROUND} through {PATH_SWITCH_TO_ROUND}, for {fee} Gold at your Renown. Unfulfilled pathbound orders are forfeited, and the whole fleet sees the change written into the voyage log.
residual.191.zh: 每航程一次，可在第{PATH_SWITCH_FROM_ROUND}至{PATH_SWITCH_TO_ROUND}航段的港口改走商道，费用{fee}金币，按你的声望计算。未交付的商道订单一并作废，全船队都会在航程日志里看到你改道。

residual.193.en: {RENOWN_BONUS_LINE}. It grows from the Reputation you bank across the voyage, so it only ever goes up, even for a captain whose books fail.
residual.193.zh: {RENOWN_BONUS_LINE}。它来自你在航程中存下的声誉，只会往上走，就算船长的账目崩了也一样。

residual.195.en: {chronicles.length} recent voyage{pluralS} shown, oldest to newest
residual.195.zh: 显示最近{chronicles.length}次航程，由旧到新

residual.196.en: Bands are read from {targetName}'s live snapshot. The Harbormaster only shares what your standing allows.
residual.196.zh: 各档数据读自{targetName}的实时快照。港务长只分享你的身份允许看到的部分。

residual.197.en: That offer belongs to an earlier leg.
residual.197.zh: 这个报价属于更早的航段。

residual.199.en: That offer was addressed to another captain.
residual.199.zh: 这个报价是写给另一位船长的。

residual.200.en: That captain has already taken on a refit this leg.
residual.200.zh: 那位船长本航段已经整补过了。

residual.201.en: You are already covered for this leg.
residual.201.zh: 本航段你已经有护卫了。

residual.202.en: Not a member of that room

residual.203.en: Pick two different items to barter.
residual.203.zh: 易货得选两样不同的物品。

residual.204.en: Each Renown level grants a small Gold bonus at the start of your next fresh voyage
residual.204.zh: 每级声望都会在你下一次全新航程开局时，送上一小笔金币奖励

residual.205.en: That captain is not in this harbor.
residual.205.zh: 那位船长不在这个港湾。

residual.206.en: A fee is a whole number of Gold, at least {CONSENT_FEE_MIN} and at most {CONSENT_FEE_MAX}.

residual.207.en: A fee is paid at the handshake and you hold {hold} Gold: this offer costs {fee}.
residual.207.zh: 费用在握手成交时付清，你手上有{hold}金币：这份报价要{fee}。

residual.208.en: An offer nobody takes before the Parley closes is gone.
residual.208.zh: 洽谈关闭前无人接下的报价就作废了。

residual.209.en: The escort costs a share of whatever you're carrying that round, so it's cheapest exactly when you have the least to protect.
residual.209.zh: 护航费从你那一轮带的货里抽成，所以手头越没什么可护，它就越便宜。

residual.210.en: The harbor is no longer counting your seat.

residual.211.en: That captain is not one the harbor is still counting.

residual.473.en:
💰 Financial Management:
1. Always maintain reserve funds for expenses
2. Maintenance + Wages are fixed round costs
3. Calculate total expenditure before buying

👥 Worker Management:
1. Weaver Wage: {weaverWage} Gold / Round
2. Master Wage: {masterWage} Gold / Round
3. Maker Wage: {sachetWage} Gold / Round
4. Hire only as needed

🔮 Broker's Whisper Strategy:
1. Buy rumors early if you have spare gold
2. Hoard revealed items to guarantee Orders profits
3. Balance intel purchases with other investments

🛒 Buying Strategy:
1. Reserve funds for maintenance+wages first
2. Select high value for money goods
3. Prioritize port specialties + revealed intel

🔄 Bartering Strategy:
1. Trade away surplus raw materials for the one you're actually short on
2. A modest Gold offer can secure a needed item faster than waiting on the next round's market
3. Cancel an offer that's sitting unclaimed if you'd rather keep the material yourself

🤝 Trading Strategy:
1. Prioritize highest profit orders
2. Consider freight impact on margins
3. Finished orders yield high profit but incur VAT

⚠️ Risk Control:
1. Calculate fixed round costs: Maintenance + Wages
2. Keep funds consistently > fixed costs
3. Avoid overexpansion cash flow issues

🏴‍☠️ Pirates and Escorts:
1. The escort fee scales with your own Gold, so it's relatively cheap exactly when you're poor and the stakes are also low
2. Hire one when you're carrying enough Gold that losing it would actually hurt
3. Sailing without one is a fair bet when you have little to lose anyway

🆘 Borrowing and Lending:
1. Repay a loan as soon as you can afford it, instead of waiting for it to be deducted automatically at Round {rounds}
2. Lending Gold raises your own reputation, so helping a captain who can clearly repay you is rarely a bad trade
3. Watch how much you've lent out across the voyage; it's still your Gold until it's actually repaid

🛡️ Backing Strategy:
1. Back a loan you'd have happily lent Gold on yourself; you're taking on the same risk without earning the lender's own full reputation rate
2. Only pledge what you can afford to lose outright, the same rule as lending directly
3. A loan to a captain who's clearly about to turn a profit is a safer backing bet than one taken late in the voyage with little runway left to repay it

💾 Save game progress frequently with Ctrl+S!
residual.473.zh:
💰 财务管理：
1. 手头永远留一笔应急资金
2. 维护费和工钱是每轮的固定开销
3. 出手采购前，先算清这一轮总共要花多少

👥 用工管理：
1. 织女工钱：每轮 {weaverWage} 金币
2. 纺织大师工钱：每轮 {masterWage} 金币
3. 香囊师工钱：每轮 {sachetWage} 金币
4. 用工按需，别多雇

🔮 掮客密语策略：
1. 手头有余钱，就早点买密语
2. 把点破的货捂紧，用来稳稳吃下订单利润
3. 情报开销和其他投资要平衡

🛒 采购策略：
1. 先把维护费和工钱留出来
2. 挑性价比高的货
3. 优先港口特产，再配上点破的情报

🔄 易货策略：
1. 多余的原材料拿去换真正短缺的那一样
2. 一笔不高的金币报价，往往比等下一轮市场更快拿到货
3. 挂着没人接的报价，与其干等，不如撤回，自己留着材料

🤝 交易策略：
1. 优先做利润最高的订单
2. 把运费对利润的影响算进去
3. 成品订单利润高，但要缴增值税

⚠️ 风险控制：
1. 算清每轮固定开销：维护费加工钱
2. 让手里的金币始终高过固定开销
3. 别贪扩张，小心周转不开

🏴‍☠️ 海盗与护航：
1. 护航费随你手上的金币浮动，越是穷的时候越便宜，那时的损失本来也小
2. 金币多到丢了会肉疼的时候，就该雇一趟护航
3. 反正没什么可输的，不雇护航也赌得起

🆘 借与贷：
1. 能还就尽早还，别拖到第{rounds}轮被自动扣还
2. 放贷长自己的声誉，借给明显还得上的船长，很少是笔亏本买卖
3. 留意整个航程放出去多少：没还回来之前，那还是你的金币

🛡️ 作保策略：
1. 只给你自己乐意放贷的那类借款作保：担的是同样的风险，却拿不到债主那份完整的声誉
2. 只押你可以干脆认赔的数目，和直接放贷一个道理
3. 作保给一位眼看就要盈利的船长，比押给航程末尾、还款空间所剩无几的那类借款稳妥

residual.283.en: The two charter rows are the window's own takes, filed once per captain per voyage when the moment is answered at leg four. The split is read inside each path, because the plan's question is which of a path's two charters captains reach for, and a path is only judged once it holds the floor the card reader reads its own card statistics over; the value names the widest judged path, so the deviation it prints and the verdict over it are about the same path. The cover row is the plan's watch rather than a gate: a charter that only traitors take has stopped being cover, so the row reads how often the salvage charters were taken by each alignment, and it is left unjudged because the plan set no threshold on it.
residual.283.zh: 两行特许数据都是本窗口自己的选取，在第四航段回答的那一刻，按人、按航程各登记一次。分化在每条商道内部读，因为计划要问的是：一条商道上的两种特许，船长们会伸手去拿哪一种。一条商道要取够卡牌读数所依据的下限，才谈得上判定；显示的值取已判定商道中最宽的那条，所以印出的偏差和它上面的判定说的是同一条商道。护卫一行是计划的观察项，不是门槛：只有叛徒才拿的特许，已经不再是护卫，所以这一行数的是各阵营取打捞特许的频率。计划没有为它设阈值，也就不作判定。

residual.337.zh: 港湾投票把{input.displayName}放逐上岸，此后的航程，他们身下再没有船。

residual.338.en: The voyage ended in bankruptcy before {input.displayName} could finish.
residual.338.zh: 航程没等{input.displayName}走完，就先破产收场了。

residual.339.en: The harbor closed the books at {input.merchantRating}.
residual.339.zh: 港湾合上账本时，商人评级停在{input.merchantRating}。

residual.340.en: 🧭 You set aside the {fromPathName} path and took up the {toPathName}. The harbor charges {fee} Gold.
residual.340.zh: 🧭 你放下{fromPathName}之道，改走{toPathName}。港湾收取{fee}金币。

residual.341.en: Papers are changed at the port, in {switchPorts}.

residual.344.zh: 🔧=== 第{state.currentRound}轮 · 结算：船只维护 ===

residual.345.zh: 🚢=== 第{state.currentRound}轮 · 暮色：船坞与模块 ===

residual.348.zh: ⚓=== 第{state.currentRound}轮 · 开市：港口采购 ===

residual.350.zh: 🤝 模块交易：{buyerName}花{trade.fee}金币买下了{name}。

residual.354.en: 🤝 Broker's Favor called in: a buyer at {order.demandPort} now wants {txt}. The bigger the ask, the bigger the Broker's cut.
residual.354.zh: 🤝 掮客的人情已兑现：{order.demandPort}的一位买家现在要{txt}。要得越多，掮客的抽成越大。

residual.355.en: 🕵️ That broker was corrupt. The word is good, but your position leaked: raid risk is up {riskPoints} points this round.
residual.355.zh: 🕵️ 那个掮客通匪。消息是真的，但你的位置泄露了：本轮的劫掠风险上升{riskPoints}点。

residual.356.zh: 🤝=== 第{state.currentRound}轮 · 订单：贸易交易 ===

residual.357.en: 🛡️ Pirates closed on your hold and met {cover.sellerName}'s guns. All {raidGold} Gold saved, and the boarding party is theirs to answer for.
residual.357.zh: 🛡️ 海盗逼近货舱，撞上了{cover.sellerName}的炮口。{raidGold}金币分文未失，登船队由他们自己去应付。

residual.358.en: 🛡️ Pirates boarded and found the hold already bare. {cover.sellerName}'s escort turned them away for nothing.
residual.358.zh: 🛡️ 海盗登船，发现货舱早已空空。{cover.sellerName}的护卫挡回了他们，却什么也没护着。

residual.363.en: 🪧 Standing orders at the shipyard: upgraded the hull to level {state.shipLevel}.
residual.363.zh: 🪧 船坞的常备订单：把船体升到了{state.shipLevel}级。

residual.364.en: ❌ That is not something the crew can wear.
residual.364.zh: ❌ 这不是船员能穿在身上的东西。

residual.365.en: ❌ There is nobody aboard to wear it.

residual.366.en: ❌ The crew can wear no more than they already have on.
residual.366.zh: ❌ 船员身上能穿的，就这些了。

residual.367.en: ❌ No {good} in the hold to wear.

residual.368.en: ❌ The crew already meets this cold leg. Clothes put on for nothing still wear, so the rest stay in the hold until a leg asks for them.
residual.368.zh: ❌ 船员们已经扛得住这个寒程了。白穿上的衣服照样会磨损，剩下的留在货舱里，等哪个航段真要了再拿出来。

residual.369.en: ❌ The sea is mild this leg and asks for no warmth. Clothes put on now would wear from today, so the hold keeps them for a cold leg.
residual.369.zh: ❌ 本航段海上温和，用不上暖意。现在穿上就要从今天开始磨损，所以货舱把它们留给寒程。

residual.370.en: 🧥 The crew puts on the {good}. Warmth {spec.warmth} while it lasts.
residual.370.zh: 🧥 船员穿上了{good}。暖意{spec.warmth}，穿多久算多久。

residual.371.en: 🧵 The {good} comes back to {after} of {spec.durability}, worth {warmthGrade} of warmth.

residual.372.en: 🧥=== Round {state.currentRound} · The Cold and the Cloth ===

residual.373.en: ❄️ A cold leg, and the crew's {warmthGrade} of warmth falls short of the {COLD_LEG_WARMTH} it asks.
residual.373.zh: ❄️ 寒程，船员的{warmthGrade}暖意不够它要的{COLD_LEG_WARMTH}。

residual.374.en: 🌊 The {garment.good} wears through to rags and is scrapped for {RAG_SCRAP_VALUE} Gold.

residual.375.en: 🧵 Worn clothes lose {step} point of wear to the sea.
residual.375.zh: 🧵 海风从穿着的衣服上耗去{step}点耐久。

residual.376.en: 🥶 There is nobody aboard to take the cold.
residual.376.zh: 🥶 船上没有人能承受这份寒冷。

residual.474.en: ❄️ A cold leg, and the crew's {warmthGrade} of warmth is enough for the {COLD_LEG_WARMTH} it asks.

residual.383.zh: 目前只有{voyages}/{LAUNCH_MINIMUM_VOYAGES}程已记录航程，低于{LAUNCH_MINIMUM_VOYAGES}程读出的门槛只是读数，还不算证据。

residual.384.en: the window was recorded at a sample rate of {samplePercent}%, so it is a sample of the run rather than the run
residual.384.zh: 窗口按{samplePercent}%的采样率记录，读到的是样本，不是全量

residual.385.en: The window was recorded at a sample rate of {samplePercent}%, so these are readings of a sample of the run rather than of the run.
residual.385.zh: 这个窗口按{samplePercent}%的采样率记录，所以这些读数来自样本，不是全量。

residual.386.en: {unmeasured.length} of the {gates.length} gates {haveWord} no source yet

residual.387.zh: {gates.length}道门槛中有{unmeasured.length}道还没有来源：{gateNames}。它们要等能产出数据的系统上线；计划不会靠碰巧可测量的那几道门槛来给一个模式放行。

residual.388.en: {unplayed.length} of the {gates.length} gates {haveWord} no voyage to read
residual.388.zh: {gates.length}道门槛中有{unplayed.length}道没有航程可读

residual.389.en: {unplayed.length} of the {gates.length} gates {haveWord} no voyage to read: {gateNames}.
residual.389.zh: {gates.length}道门槛中有{unplayed.length}道没有航程可读：{gateNames}。

residual.390.en: the window holds {unreadable} {recordWord} that could not be read
residual.390.zh: 窗口里有{unreadable}条记录读不出来

residual.391.en: The window holds {unreadable} {recordWord} that could not be read, so it is that much smaller than the run it was taken from.
residual.391.zh: 窗口里有{unreadable}条记录读不出来，比它抽自的那批数据就小了这么多。

residual.392.en: the window holds {truncated} {recordWord} that hit the event cap
residual.392.zh: 窗口里有{truncated}条记录触及事件上限

residual.393.en: The window holds {truncated} {recordWord} that hit the event cap, so some of what happened in those voyages was never kept and the gates read over them are floors rather than readings.
residual.393.zh: 窗口里有{truncated}条记录触及事件上限，这些航程里发生的事，有一部分没能留下；靠它们读出的门槛只是下限，不算读数。

residual.394.en: {ungated.length} of the {gates.length} gates answer a reading the plan set no threshold on
residual.394.zh: {gates.length}道门槛中有{ungated.length}道对应的读数计划没有设阈值

residual.395.en: {ungated.length} of the {gates.length} gates answer readings the plan set no threshold on: {gateNames}. That is a contradiction in the page rather than a reading, and it is named here rather than passed over.
residual.395.zh: {gates.length}道门槛中有{ungated.length}道对应的读数计划没有设阈值：{gateNames}。这是页面自身的矛盾，不是读数；就在这里点出来，不放过去。

residual.397.en: Clear to ship: all {total} gates sit inside their bands over {voyages} recorded voyages.
residual.397.zh: 可放行：全部{total}道门槛都在各自区间内，覆盖{voyages}程已记录航程。

residual.399.en: {head} {untradeable.line.label} is the plan's own priority and cannot be traded against the others.
residual.399.zh: {head} {untradeable.line.label}是计划自己的优先级，不能拿去和其余门槛做交换。

residual.400.en: No verdict yet: the reading leaves gates to read.
residual.400.zh: 尚无判定：这次读数还有门槛可读。

residual.404.en: Finish an {openWaters.name} voyage without going bankrupt.
residual.404.zh: 完成一程{openWaters.name}航程，且没有破产。

residual.405.en: "{kept.id}" is preserved and keeps {keptLegs} legs while "{turning.id}" is perishable and keeps {turningLegs}, so the tag and the keeping disagree.
residual.405.zh: “{kept.id}”是耐储货，能存{keptLegs}个航段；而“{turning.id}”是易腐货，只存{turningLegs}个，标签和保鲜期对不上。

residual.406.en: The harbor weighs anchor for the {phaseName}.

residual.407.en: {facts.captain}'s offer of {facts.offerAmount} {facts.offerItem} lapses with the leg.
residual.407.zh: 本航段一结束，{facts.captain}挂出的{facts.offerAmount}份{facts.offerItem}报价就作废了。

residual.408.en: The tide runs out on the {phaseName}.

residual.410.en: {facts.captain} sets aside their old papers and takes up the {pathName} path.

residual.417.en: {account} is banned. Unban the account first.

residual.422.en: The maroon vote opens from leg {facts.maroonFrom}.
residual.422.zh: 放逐投票从第{facts.maroonFrom}航段起开放。

residual.423.en: The Harbormaster's hand is not dealt before leg {facts.maroonFrom}.
residual.423.zh: 第{facts.maroonFrom}航段之前，港务长之手还不发放。

residual.425.en: You already have an offer standing for {buyerName}.
residual.425.zh: 你已经为{buyerName}挂着一份报价了。

residual.427.en: Word on the Docks: {s.user.displayName} was first to complete {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD} trade orders this voyage, and pockets {WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_REWARD} Gold for it.
residual.427.zh: 码头风闻：{s.user.displayName}在本航程率先完成了{WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_THRESHOLD}笔订单，把这{WORD_ON_THE_DOCKS_REWARD}金币装进了口袋。

residual.430.en: Deadline must be between round {minRound} and round {maxRound}.
residual.430.zh: 截止轮次得在第{minRound}轮到第{maxRound}轮之间。

residual.431.en: {input.displayName} sailed {waters} and ran out of Gold before the voyage was done.
residual.431.zh: {input.displayName}在{waters}中跑了一程，中途金币耗尽，没能走完航程。

residual.483.en: {s.user.displayName} posted a Venture: {targetGold} Gold needed by Round {deadlineRound}.
residual.483.zh: {s.user.displayName}挂出了一笔合股：{targetGold}金币，第{deadlineRound}轮前凑齐。

fragment.manifest_flagged.en: The harbor's own checks could not reconcile this manifest, so its lines are withheld.
fragment.manifest_flagged.zh: 港湾自己的核验对不上这份舱单，内容就不公开。

fragment.manifest_sample.en: A random sample of this captain's most recent order fulfillments, opened by a vote of the harbor. Their card, their Gold and the rest of their hold were not opened.
fragment.manifest_sample.zh: 港湾投票开出的抽样，取自这位船长最近交付的订单。他的手牌、金币和货舱里其余的东西都没有打开。
